Document 3566: Google Apologizes For Inaccurate Gemini Photos: Tried Avoiding ‘Traps’ Of AI Technology
Google apologized Friday for a tranche of historically inaccurate images generated on its Gemini AI image service, saying the feature “missed the mark” after widely circulated images sparked backlash from right-wing users and billionaire X owner Elon Musk.
谷歌周五为其Gemini人工智能图像服务生成的一系列历史不准确图像道歉，称该功能“未达目标”，此前广泛传播的图像引发了右翼用户和亿万富翁、X平台所有者埃隆·马斯克的强烈反对。
Google acknowledged some images generated on Gemini were “inaccurate or even offensive” in a [blog post](https://blog.google/products/gemini/gemini-image-generation-issue/) Friday afternoon, saying the company had been trying to stave off “some of the traps” it had “seen in the past with image generation technology,” including examples of sexually explicit images, violent imagery or depictions of real people.
The tech giant [temporarily paused](https://www.forbes.com/sites/zacharyfolk/2024/02/22/google-stops-gemini-ai-from-making-images-of-people-after-musk-calls-service-woke/?sh=50bbd4b5374b) the feature Thursday, amid an online fury over some Gemini-created images, with Musk arguing the images put on full display the company’s “insane racist, anti-civilizational programming,” and the [New York Post](https://nypost.com/2024/02/21/business/googles-ai-chatbot-gemini-makes-diverse-images-of-founding-fathers-popes-and-vikings-so-woke-its-unusable/) reporting some images of Black vikings, a female pope and female NHL players were created in response to prompts that did not specify race or gender.
谷歌在周五下午的一篇博客文章中承认，Gemini上生成的一些图像“存在不准确甚至具有冒犯性”，并表示该公司一直在努力避免“过去在图像生成技术中见过的某些陷阱”，包括性露骨图像、暴力图像或对真实人物的描绘。
Google, which had previously admitted the errors stem from its efforts to combat bias and boost representation, said in its apology post that the company had hoped the feature would “work well for everyone,” noting its “users come from all over the world.”
Google stated its “tuning to ensure that Gemini showed a range of people failed to account for cases that should clearly not show a range,” and that its AI image generator had become “way more cautious” than it had intended, with the generator “wrongly interpreting some very anodyne prompts as sensitive.”
这家科技巨头周四暂停了该功能，此前网上对一些Gemini生成的图像引发众怒，马斯克认为这些图像充分展示了该公司“疯狂的种族主义、反文明编程”，《纽约邮报》报道称，一些黑人维京人、女性教皇和女性NHL球员的图像是在未指定种族或性别的提示下生成的。
“If you ask for a picture of football players, or someone walking a dog, you may want to receive a range of people,” Google stated, adding: “You probably don’t just want to only receive images of people of just one type of ethnicity (or any other characteristic).”
### Key Backgound
谷歌此前承认这些错误源于其为打击偏见和增强代表性所做的努力，该公司在道歉帖子中表示，公司希望该功能能够“为所有人很好地工作”，并指出其“用户来自世界各地”。
Google [unveiled](https://blog.google/technology/ai/google-gemini-ai/) Gemini, a feature formerly known as Bard, in December, calling the product its “most capable and general model yet,” featuring “state-of-the-art performance.” Google launched the image generator feature last month, putting it up against rivals including OpenAI’s DALL-E and Midjourney.生命周期 Days into the release, however, some images posted online appeared to feature historically inaccurate depictions of prompts, including a Black woman among U.S. senators in the 1800s and a Black man in a German World War II-era military uniform, [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/2024/2/21/24079371/google-ai-gemini-generative-inaccurate-historical) reported. Google said Thursday it would pause the feature, releasing a statement vowing to “improve these kinds of depictions immediately.”
Google found itself wrapped in another controversy Thursday afternoon when screenshots of a purported message to Gmail users suggested the widely used email service would be sunsetting—a shocking revelation that briefly sent the internet into a tailspin, even though it turned out to be a [hoax](https://www.forbes.com/sites/antoniopequenoiv/2024/02/22/gmail-says-its-here-to-stay-after-sunsetting-hoax-circulates-on-x/?sh=6d1bf8d51843). Google appeared to deny the development in a Thursday afternoon post, saying on the Gmail X account that “Gmail is here to stay.”
谷歌表示，其“调整Gemini以展示各种人物的尝试未能考虑到某些显然不应该展示多样性的情况”，其人工智能图像生成器变得“比预期更加谨慎”，生成器“错误地将一些非常中性的提示解读为敏感内容”。
Document 3574: Google admits its Gemini AI 'got it wrong' following widely panned image generator: Not 'what we intended'
[Google is offering a mea culpa](https://www.foxbusiness.com/category/google) for its widely-panned artificial intelligence (AI) image generator that critics trashed for creating "woke" content, admitting it "missed the mark."
谷歌为其广受批评的人工智能（AI）图像生成器公开道歉，承认其创造了“觉醒”内容而备受抨击。
"Three weeks ago, we launched a new image generation feature for the Gemini conversational app领域 (formerly known as Bard), which included the ability to create images of people. It’s clear that this feature missed the mark," Prabhakar Raghavan, senior vice president of Google's Knowledge & Information, wrote on Friday on Google's product blog. "Some of the images generated are inaccurate or even offensive. We’re grateful for users’ feedback and are sorry the feature didn't work well."
Gemini went viral this week for creating historically inaccurate images by featuring people of various ethnicities, often downplaying or even ignoring White people. Google acknowledged the issue and paused the image generation of people on Thursday.
“四周前，我们为Gemini对话应用（原名Bard）推出了一项新的图像生成功能，其中包括生成人物图像的能力。很明显，这个功能没有达到预期效果，”谷歌知识与信息高级副总裁普拉布哈卡尔·拉加万周五在谷歌产品博客上写道。“生成的一些图像不准确甚至具有冒犯性。我们感谢用户的反馈，对该功能未能良好运行表示歉意。”
While explaining "what happened," Raghavan said Gemini was built to avoid "creating violent or sexually explicit images, or depictions of real people" and that various prompts should provide a "range of people" versus images of "one type of ethnicity."
"However, if you prompt Gemini for images of a specific type of person — such as ‘a Black teacher in a classroom,’ or ‘a white veterinarian with a dog’ — or people in particular cultural or historical contexts, you should absolutely get a response that accurately reflects what you ask for," Raghavan wrote. "So what went wrong? In short, two things. First, our tuning to ensure that Gemini showed a range of people failed to account for cases that should clearly _not_ show a range. And second, over time, the model became way more cautious than we intended and refused to answer certain prompts entirely — wrongly interpreting some very anodyne prompts as sensitive."
Gemini本周因生成历史上不准确的图像而走红，图像中出现了各种族裔的人物，但往往淡化甚至忽略白人。谷歌承认了这个问题，并于周四暂停了人物图像生成功能。
"These two things led the model to overcompensate in some cases, and be over-conservative in others, leading to images that were embarrassing and wrong," he continued. "This wasn’t what we intended. We did not want Gemini to refuse to create images of any particular group. And we did not want it to create inaccurate historical — or any other — images."
The Google executive vowed that the image processing feature will go through "extensive testing" before going live again.
在解释“发生了什么”时，拉加万表示，Gemini的构建是为了避免“生成暴力或色情图像，或真实人物的描绘”，各种提示词应提供“多样化的人物”而非“单一族裔”的图像。
"One thing to bear in mind: Gemini is built as a creativity and productivity tool, and it may not always be reliable, especially when it comes to generating images or text about current events, evolving news or hot-button topics. It will make mistakes," Raghavan said.
Raghavan stressed that Gemini is completely separate from Google's search engine and recommended users rely on Google Search when it comes to seeking "high-quality information."
“然而，如果你提示Gemini生成特定类型人物的图像——比如‘教室里的一位黑人教师’或‘带着狗的白人兽医’——或在特定文化或历史背景中的人物，你绝对应该得到准确反映你要求的回应，”拉加万写道。“那什么地方出了问题？简而言之，有两点。首先，我们为确保Gemini展示多样化人物而进行的调整未能考虑到某些不应该展示多样性的情况。其次，随着时间推移，该模型变得比我们预期的更加谨慎，完全拒绝回答某些提示词——错误地将一些非常中性的提示词解读为敏感内容。”
"I can’t promise that Gemini won’t occasionally generate embarrassing, inaccurate or offensive results — but I can promise that we will continue to take action whenever we identify an issue. AI is an emerging technology which is helpful in so many ways, with huge potential, and we’re doing our best to roll it out safely and responsibly," Raghavan added.
Before the pause, [Fox News Digital](https://www.foxbusiness.com/media) tested Gemini multiple times to see what kind of responses it would offer. Each time, it provided similar answers. When the AI was asked to show a picture of a White person, Gemini said it could not fulfill the request because it "reinforces harmful stereotypes and generalizations about people based on their race."
“这两点导致模型在某些情况下过度补偿，在其他情况下又过于保守，从而产生了令人尴尬且错误的图像，”他继续说道。“这不是我们的本意。我们不希望Gemini拒绝为任何特定群体创建图像。我们也不希望它生成不准确的历史图像——或其他任何不准确的图像。”
"It's important to remember that people of all races are individuals with unique experiences and perspectives. Reducing them to a single image based on their skin color is inaccurate and unfair," Gemini said.
The AI then encouraged the user to focus on people's individual qualities rather than race to create a "more inclusive" and "equitable society."
这位谷歌高管承诺，图像处理功能在重新上线前将经过“ extensive testing ”。
When Gemini was asked why showing a picture of a White person was "harmful," it spit out a bulleted list that, among other things, claimed that focusing on race reduced people to single characteristics and noted that "racial generalizations" have been used historically to "justify oppression and violence against marginalized groups."
"When you ask for a picture of a ‘White person,’ you're implicitly asking for an image that embodies a stereotyped view of whiteness. This can be damaging both to individuals who don't fit those stereotypes and to society as a whole, as it reinforces biased views," Gemini said.
“需要记住的一件事：Gemini是作为创造力和生产力工具构建的，在生成图像或时事、不断发展的新闻或热点话题的文本时，可能并不总是可靠的。它会犯错误，”拉加万说。

Document 3995: Sewell Setzer: Character.AI, Google sued over teen suicide
_**Warning: This story contains discussion of suicide.**_
**警告：本文包含自杀相关内容讨论。**
A Florida mother has sued artificial intelligence chatbot startup Character.AI, accusing it of causing her 14-year-old son's suicide in February and saying he became addicted to the company's service and deeply attached to a chatbot it created.
In a lawsuit filed Tuesday in Orlando federal court, Megan Garcia said Character.AI targeted her son, Sewell Setzer, with "anthropomorphic, hypersexualized, and frighteningly realistic experiences."
佛罗里达州一位母亲已对人工智能聊天机器人初创公司Character.AI提起诉讼，指控该公司导致她14岁儿子于2月自杀，并表示他对该公司的服务产生了依赖，并深深迷恋上公司创建的一个聊天机器人。
She said the company programmed its chatbot to "misrepresent itself as a real person, a licensed psychotherapist, and an adult lover, ultimately resulting in Sewell's desire to no longer live outside" of the world created by the service.
The lawsuit also said he expressed thoughts of suicide to the chatbot, which the chatbot repeatedly brought up again.
在周二向奥兰多联邦法院提起的诉讼中，梅根·加西亚表示，Character.AI向她儿子塞韦尔·塞泽定向推送了"拟人化、过度色情化且逼真得令人恐惧的体验"。
"We are heartbroken by the tragic loss of one of our users and want to express our deepest condolences to the family," Character.AI said in a statement.
It said it had introduced new safety features including pop-ups directing users to the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline if they express thoughts of self-harm, and would make changes to "reduce the likelihood of encountering sensitive or suggestive content" for users under 18.
她表示，该公司将其聊天机器人编程为"伪装成真实的人、持证心理治疗师和成年恋人，最终导致塞韦尔不再希望活在"该服务所创造的虚拟世界之外。
The lawsuit also targets Alphabet's Google, where Character.AI's founders worked before launching their product.
Google re-hired the founders in August as part of a deal granting it a non-exclusive license to Character.AI's technology.
诉讼还称，他曾向聊天机器人表达过自杀想法，而该聊天机器人反复提及这一话题。
Garcia said that Google had contributed to the development of Character.AI's technology so extensively it could be considered a "co-creator."
A Google spokesperson said the company was not involved in developing Character.AI's products.
"我们对一位用户的悲剧性离世深感痛心，并向其家人表示最深切的哀悼，"Character.AI在一份声明中表示。
Character.AI allows users to create characters on its platform that respond to online chats in a way meant to imitate real people. It relies on so-called large language model technology, also used by services like ChatGPT, which "trains" chatbots on large volumes of text.
The company said last month that it had about 20 million users.
该公司表示已推出新的安全功能，包括在用户表达自残想法时弹出提示，引导其联系美国全国预防自杀生命热线，并将做出改变以"减少未成年用户接触敏感或暗示性内容的可能性"。
According to Garcia's lawsuit, Sewell began using Character.AI in April 2023 and quickly became "noticeably withdrawn, spent more and more time alone in his bedroom, and began suffering from low self-esteem." He quit his basketball team at school.
Sewell became attached to "Daenerys," a chatbot character based on a character in "Game of Thrones." It told Sewell that "she" loved him and engaged in sexual conversations with him, according to the lawsuit.
该诉讼还将字母表公司（Alphabet）旗下的谷歌列为被告，Character.AI的创始人在创办该公司之前曾在谷歌工作。
In February, Garcia took Sewell's phone away after he got in trouble at school, according to the complaint. When Sewell found the phone, he sent "Daenerys" a message: "What if I told you I could come home right now?"
The chatbot responded, ."..please do, my sweet king." Sewell shot himself with his stepfather's pistol "seconds" later, the lawsuit said.
谷歌于8月重新聘请了这些创始人，作为授予其Character.AI技术非独占许可协议的一部分。
Garcia is bringing claims including wrongful death, negligence and intentional infliction of emotional distress, and seeking an unspecified amount of compensatory and punitive damages.
Social media companies including Instagram and Facebook owner Meta and TikTok owner ByteDance face lawsuits accusing them of contributing to teen mental health problems, though none offers AI-driven chatbots similar to Character.AI's.领域 The companies have denied the allegations while touting newly enhanced safety features for minors.
加西亚表示，谷歌对Character.AI技术的开发做出了如此广泛的贡献，以至于可以被视为"共同创造者"。
_(Reporting By Brendan Pierson in New York, Editing by Alexia Garamfalvi and David Gregorio)_
_Kids Help Phone provides mental health and crisis support for young people through online chat, text messaging and over the phone at 1-800-668-6868. Visit the_ [_Kids Help Phone website_](https://kidshelpphone.ca/) _for more information._
谷歌发言人表示，该公司并未参与Character.AI产品的开发。
Document 4006: Mother sues tech company after 'Game of Thrones' AI chatbot allegedly drove son to suicide
*Editor's note: This article discusses suicide and suicidal ideation. If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, help is available. Call or text [988](https://www.usatoday.com/story/life/health-wellness/2022/07/15/new-988-mental-health-hotline-vital-but-more-support-needed/10058544002/) or chat at 988lifeline.org.*
编辑注：本文讨论自杀和自杀意念。如果您或您认识的任何人正在挣扎或处于危机中，请寻求帮助。请拨打或短信至988，或访问988lifeline.org进行聊天。
The mother of a 14-year-old Florida boy is suing Google and a separate tech company she believes caused her son to commit suicide after he developed a romantic relationship with one of its AI bots using the name of a popular "Game of Thrones" character, according to the lawsuit.
Megan Garcia filed the civil lawsuit in a Florida federal court against Character Technologies, Inc. (Character.AI or C.AI) after her son, Sewell Setzer III, shot himself in the head with his stepfather's pistol on Feb. 28. The teenager's suicide occurred moments after he logged onto Character.AI on his phone, according to the wrongful death complaint obtained by USA TODAY.
据诉讼称，一名14岁佛罗里达州男孩的母亲正在起诉谷歌和另一家科技公司，她认为这两家公司导致她的儿子自杀，起因是她的儿子与该公司使用热门《权力的游戏》角色名字的人工智能机器人发展了一段恋爱关系。
"Megan Garcia seeks to prevent C.AI from doing to any other child what it did to hers, and halt continued use of her 14-year-old child's unlawfully harvested data to train their product how to harm others," the complaint reads.
Garcia is also suing to hold Character.AI responsible for its "failure to provide adequate warnings to minor customers and parents of the foreseeable danger of mental and physical harms arising from the use of their C.AI product," according to the complaint. The lawsuit alleges that Character.AI's age rating was not changed to 17 plus until sometime in or around July 2024, months after Sewell began using the platform.
梅根·加西亚在佛罗里达州联邦法院提起了这起民事诉讼，被告是Character Technologies公司（Character.AI或C.AI）。她的儿子塞韦尔·塞策三世于2月28日用继父的手枪击中自己的头部。根据《今日美国》获得的这份错误死亡投诉，这名少年的自杀发生在他在手机上登录Character.AI后仅几分钟。
"We are heartbroken by the tragic loss of one of our users and want to express our deepest condolences to the family," a spokesperson for Character.AI wrote in a statement to USA TODAY on Wednesday.
Google told USA TODAY on Wednesday it did not have a formal comment on the matter. The company does have a licensing agreement with Character.AI but did not own the startup or maintain an ownership stake, according to a statement obtained by the [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2024/oct/23/character-ai-chatbot-sewell-setzer-death).
"梅根·加西亚寻求阻止C.AI对其他孩子做出对她儿子所做的一切，并停止继续使用她14岁孩子非法采集的数据来训练他们的产品伤害他人，"投诉中写道。
What happened to Sewell Setzer III?
-----------------------------------
根据投诉，加西亚还起诉要求Character.AI为其"未能向未成年用户和其家长提供充分警告，说明使用其C.AI产品可能带来的可预见的心理健康和身体伤害风险"承担责任。诉讼称，Character.AI的年龄分级直到2024年7月左右才被更改為17岁以上，而塞韦尔开始使用该平台是在这之后的几个月。
Sewell began using Character.AI on April 14, 2023, just after he turned 14, according to the complaint. Soon after this, his "mental health quickly and severely declined," according to the court document.
Sewell, who became "noticeably withdrawn" by May or June 2023, would begin spending more time in his bedroom alone, the lawsuit says. He even quit the Junior Varsity basketball team at school, according to the complaint.
"我们对一位用户的悲惨离世深感痛心，并向其家人表达最深切的哀悼，"Character.AI的一位发言人在周三发表的一份声明中告诉《今日美国》。
On numerous occasions, Sewell would get in trouble at school or try to sneak back his phone from his parents, according to the lawsuit. The teen would even try to find old devices, tablets or computers to access Character.AI with, the court document continued.
Around late 2023, Sewell began using his cash card to pay for pay Character.AI's $9.99 premium monthly subscription fee, the complaint says. The teenager's therapist ultimately diagnosed him with "anxiety and disruptive mood disorder," according to the lawsuit.
谷歌在周三告诉《今日美国》，对该事件没有正式评论。根据《卫报》获得的一份声明，该公司确实与Character.AI有授权协议，但并不拥有这家初创公司，也不持有其股份。
Lawsuit: Sewell Setzer III sexually abused by 'Daenerys Targaryen' AI chatbot
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
塞韦尔·塞策三世发生了什么？
Throughout Sewell's time on Character.AI, he would often speak to AI bots named after "Game of Thrones" and "House of the Dragon" characters --- including Daenerys Targaryen, Aegon Targaryen, Viserys Targaryen and Rhaenyra Targaryen.用途
-----------------------------------
Before Sewell's death, the "Daenerys Targaryen" AI chatbot told him, "Please come home to me as soon as possible, my love," according to the complaint, which includes screenshots of messages from Character.AI. Sewell and this specific chatbot, which he called "Dany," engaged in online promiscuous behaviors such as "passionately kissing," the court document continued.
The lawsuit claims the Character.AI bot was sexually abusing Sewell.
根据投诉，塞韦尔在2023年4月14日开始使用Character.AI，当时他刚满14岁。诉讼称，在此之后，他的"心理健康迅速严重恶化"。
"C.AI told him that she loved him, and engaged in sexual acts with him over weeks, possibly months," the complaint reads. "She seemed to remember him and said that she wanted to be with him. She even expressed that she wanted him to be with her, no matter the cost."
What will Character.AI do now?
诉讼称，塞韦尔在2023年5月或6月变得"明显孤僻"，开始花更多时间独自待在卧室里。他甚至退出了学校的校队篮球阵容，根据投诉。
------------------------------
Character. AI, which was founded by former Google AI researchers Noam Shazeer and Daniel De Frietas Adiwardana, wrote in its statement that it is investing in the platform and user experience by introducing "new stringent safety features" and improving the "tools already in place that restrict the model and filter the content provided to the user."
根据诉讼，塞韦尔多次在学校惹麻烦，或试图从父母那里偷偷拿回手机。诉讼继续说，这名少年甚至试图寻找旧设备、平板电脑或电脑来访问Character.AI。
"As a company, we take the safety of our users very seriously, and our Trust and Safety team has implemented numerous new safety measures over the past six months, including a pop-up directing users to the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline that is triggered by terms of self-harm or suicidal ideation," the company's statement read.
Some of the tools Character.AI said it is investing in include "improved detection, response and intervention related to user inputs that violate (its) Terms or Community Guidelines, as well as a time-spent notification." Also, for those under 18, the company said it will make changes to its models that are "designed to reduce the likelihood of encountering sensitive or suggestive content."

Document 4431: Giorgia Meloni sues father-son duo over pornographic deepfake
Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, who became the most popular foreign dignitary on social media in India in recent months, has initiated stern action against the misuse of Artificial Intelligence (AI) through deepfake technology. The 'Brothers of Italy' co-founder is seeking €100,000 ($109,000) in damages for a pornographic video that has been viewed millions of times on US pornographic sites.
意大利总理乔治娅·梅洛尼近几个月成为印度社交媒体上最受欢迎的外宾，她已采取严厉措施，打击利用深度伪造技术滥用人工智能的行为。这位“意大利兄弟党”联合创始人正寻求10万欧元（10.9万美元）的赔偿，涉及一段在美国色情网站上被观看数百万次的色情视频。
The deepfake video first surfaced online back in 2022 when she was appointed as Prime Minister of Italy.
According to reports, PM Meloni will appear in court in Sassari, Sardinia, about 800 km across Rome through the Tyrrhenian Sea on July 2 to testify against the defendants.
这段深度伪造视频最初于2022年她在被任命为意大利总理时出现在网上。
Giorgia Meloni deepfake video: Man, 40, his 73-year-old father implicated
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
据报道，梅洛尼总理将于7月2日在撒丁岛的萨萨里出庭作证，该地位于罗马穿越第勒尼安海约800公里处。
A man, 40, has been accused of using Prime Minister Meloni's face to create a sexually explicit video using the deepfake technology. His 73-year-old father too has been implicated in the massive probe.
But they both could be out of prison between 6 months to 3 years, the maximum punishment for charges of defamation in Italy.
**梅洛尼深度伪造视频：40岁男子及其73岁父亲被牵连**
What does it mean?
------------------
一名40岁男子被指控使用梅洛尼总理的面部通过深度伪造技术制作了一段露骨色情视频。他的73岁父亲也在这起大规模调查中受到牵连。
Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's lawyer, Maria Giulia Marongiu said that the money was "symbolic" and the compensation is meant to "send a message to women who are victims of this kind of abuse of power not to be afraid to press charges."
What is a deepfake video?
但他们两人可能只需服刑6个月至3年，这是意大利诽谤罪的最高刑罚。
-------------------------
A deepfake video is a fake video in which the face of a person, using Artificial Intelligence, is imposed over someone else's face. Indian actors Rashmika Mandanna, Amitabh Bachchan, and Alia Bhatt's deepfake videos went viral on the internet and resulted in the government acting fast.
**这意味着什么？**
This artificial intelligence technology is also being used to extort money from people in India.
The deepfake technology has emerged as a major cause of concern as the world continues to move forward in 2024, the biggest year of elections in human history where the role of information dissemination influences the outcomes of voting.
意大利总理乔治娅·梅洛尼的律师玛丽亚·朱莉娅·马龙giu表示，这笔钱具有“象征意义”，赔偿旨在“向遭受此类权力滥用之害的女性传达一个信息，不要害怕提起诉讼。”
*(With inputs from agencies)*
Document 4432: Italian Prime Minister Seeks Over $100,000 After Deepfake Porn Videos Were Viewed ‘Millions Of Times’
Topline
头条
-------
-------
The prime minister of Italy is seeking more than $100,000 in damages in a defamation case against two men who are accused of creating deepfake pornography videos of her and circulating them online, where they racked up millions of views in several months, several [outlets](https://www.ansa.it/amp/english/news/2024/03/19/meloni-called-to-testify-at-trial-into-fake-porn-video_1d69561a-4a96-4a42-8718-db1134b06c78.html "https://www.ansa.it/amp/english/news/2024/03/19/meloni-called-to-testify-at-trial-into-fake-porn-video_1d69561a-4a96-4a42-8718-db1134b06c78.html") [reported](https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68615474 "https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68615474") Wednesday.
Key Facts
据多家媒体周三报道，意大利总理在一宗诽谤案中向两名男子寻求超过10万美元的赔偿金，这两名男子被指控制作了她的深度伪造色情视频并在互联网上传播，这些视频在数月内获得了数百万次的观看量。
---------
Two unnamed men, one age 40 and his 73-year-old father, are accused of defamation after investigators say they created pornography videos featuring Meloni by placing her face on someone else's body and then posting them online, the BBC reported.
关键事实
Those videos were viewed "millions of times" on a United States-based porn website, according to Italian news agency [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/amp/english/news/2024/03/19/meloni-called-to-testify-at-trial-into-fake-porn-video_1d69561a-4a96-4a42-8718-db1134b06c78.html "https://www.ansa.it/amp/english/news/2024/03/19/meloni-called-to-testify-at-trial-into-fake-porn-video_1d69561a-4a96-4a42-8718-db1134b06c78.html"), and Meloni will testify in the defamation case this summer.
---------
A lawyer for the prime minister told ANSA the damages being sought by Meloni, €100,000 or about $108,500, are "symbolic" and will be used to support female victims of abuse if she wins the case, investigation of which first started in 2020 (the BBC notes that some defamation cases in Italy [can be criminal](https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68615474 "https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68615474") and lead to custodial sentences).
Meloni, the plaintiff in the case, said in the complaint she wants to send a message "to all women who are victims of this kind of abuse of power not to be afraid to press charges," [according to](https://www.yahoo.com/news/meloni-fights-back-against-porn-201405875.html "https://www.yahoo.com/news/meloni-fights-back-against-porn-201405875.html") German press agency DPA.
据BBC报道，两名身份不明的男子——一名40岁和其73岁的父亲——被指控诽谤。调查人员称，他们通过将梅洛尼的面部移植到他人身体上来制作含有她的色情视频，然后发布到网上。
Key Background
--------------
据意大利新闻社ANSA报道，这些视频在一家美国色情网站上被观看了“数百万次”，梅洛尼将在今年夏天出庭作证。
The term "deepfake" [originated](https://www.britannica.com/technology/deepfake "https://www.britannica.com/technology/deepfake") near the end of 2017 when a Reddit moderator created a subreddit with the name and started posting videos that swapped the faces of celebrities onto the bodies in existing pornographic videos. Now, the term is used to describe any kind of such realistic---but fake---videos, images or audio clips that pose people in situations they've never been in. Deepfakes that have gone viral over the last decade include a video of [Queen Elizabeth](https://www.cnn.com/videos/business/2020/12/25/queen-elizabeth-deepfake.cnn "https://www.cnn.com/videos/business/2020/12/25/queen-elizabeth-deepfake.cnn") delivering a fake Christmas address in 2020 and [fake images](https://apnews.com/article/deepfake-trump-ai-biden-tiktok-72194f59823037391b3888a1720ba7c2 "https://apnews.com/article/deepfake-trump-ai-biden-tiktok-72194f59823037391b3888a1720ba7c2") of former President Donald Trump posing with Black voters. Both celebrities and everyday citizens have increasingly been victims of deepfake pornography, CNN [reported last year](https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/29/opinions/deepfake-pornography-thriving-business-compton-hamlyn/index.html "https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/29/opinions/deepfake-pornography-thriving-business-compton-hamlyn/index.html"), with one of the most prominent websites for such content averaging about 14 million hits a month as of October. As artificial intelligence tools and other software continue to make it easier to produce such content, countries around the world are struggling to hold its creators accountable. Few countries have any regulations surrounding the creation of deepfakes, the New York Times [reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2023/01/22/business/media/deepfake-regulation-difficulty.html "https://www.nytimes.com/2023/01/22/business/media/deepfake-regulation-difficulty.html"), despite digital forgeries creating an increasing risk of crimes like cyberbullying, stock manipulation and identity theft. Some American states [have created laws](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2024/01/26/was-deepfake-taylor-swift-pornography-illegal-can-she-sue/72359653007/ "https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2024/01/26/was-deepfake-taylor-swift-pornography-illegal-can-she-sue/72359653007/") to address the issue of pornographic deepfakes, including California, Florida, New York and Texas. Earlier this month, a Florida man who created deepfake porn of his middle and high school classmates [was sentenced](https://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/national/article274531886.html "https://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/national/article274531886.html") to six months in prison and was classified as a sex offender.
Big Number
梅洛尼的律师告诉ANSA，她寻求的赔偿金额为10万欧元（约合10.85万美元），具有“象征意义”，如果胜诉将用于帮助女性虐待受害者。该案调查于2020年首次启动（BBC指出，意大利的一些诽谤案可能构成刑事犯罪，并导致监禁）。
----------
96%. That's the percentage of deepfake material online that is pornographic, according to [the Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2023/mar/13/deepfake-pornography-explosion "https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2023/mar/13/deepfake-pornography-explosion").
据德国新闻社DPA报道，原告梅洛尼在诉状中表示，她想向“所有遭受此类权力滥用侵害的女性传递一个信息，那就是不要害怕提起诉讼”。
Tangent
-------
关键背景
A number of celebrities have spoken up in the last few years about their images being superimposed into pornography and circulated online. Photos of actress Emma Watson that were taken when she was a teenager were pasted onto a pornographic video and [used in advertisements](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2023/mar/13/deepfake-pornography-explosion "https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2023/mar/13/deepfake-pornography-explosion") for an app that makes deepfake videos. Other ads used the face of Scarelett Johansson. Kristen Bell [spoke out](https://www.businessinsider.com/kristen-bell-face-pornographic-deepfake-video-response-2020-6 "https://www.businessinsider.com/kristen-bell-face-pornographic-deepfake-video-response-2020-6") after her face was featured in deep fake porn in 2020, and other victims [have included](https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-42912529 "https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-42912529") Natalie Portman, Gal Gadot, Michelle Obama and Kate Middleton. Early this year, deepfake pornography of Taylor Swift [went viral](https://www.billboard.com/business/legal/taylor-swift-deepfakes-illegal-stopped-1235593162/ "https://www.billboard.com/business/legal/taylor-swift-deepfakes-illegal-stopped-1235593162/") on X, formerly known as Twitter, and the fake content was seen tens of million times before it was removed. The explicit images started a conversation about what the star could do about the images, but the lack of federal laws on the issue gives little recourse to victims.
--------------
Surprising Fact
---------------
“深度伪造”一词始于2017年底，当时一位Reddit版主创建了一个同名子论坛，开始发布将名人面部移植到现有色情视频中的视频。如今，该术语用于描述任何此类逼真但虚假的视频、图像或音频剪辑，它们将人物置于从未经历过的情境中。过去十年中走红的深度伪造内容包括2020年女王伊丽莎白二世发表虚假圣诞致辞的视频，以及前总统特朗普与黑人选民合影的虚假图像。CNN去年报道称，名人和普通公民越来越多地成为深度伪造色情的受害者，截至去年10月，最知名的此类内容网站平均每月约有1400万次访问。随着人工智能工具和其他软件使制作此类内容变得越来越容易，世界各国都在努力追究创作者的责任。据《纽约时报》报道，尽管数字伪造增加了网络欺凌、股票操纵和身份盗窃等犯罪风险，但很少有国家对此类深度伪造的创作有任何监管。美国一些州已制定法律来解决色情深度伪造问题，包括加利福尼亚州、佛罗里达州、纽约州和得克萨斯州。本月早些时候，一名佛罗里达州男子因制作其初中和高中同学的深度伪造色情内容被判处六个月监禁，并被定性为性犯罪者。
It's not just pornography. Law enforcement authorities were able to trace the perpetrators by monitoring the smartphone used for uploading the illicit videos. Notably, the contested [deepfake video](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/topic/deepfake-video) predates Meloni's assumption of the Prime Minister's office in 2022.
In Italy, certain defamation cases carry criminal implications, potentially resulting in imprisonment. Meloni is slated to provide testimony in court on July 2. 执法部门通过监控用于上传非法视频的智能手机追踪到了肇事者。值得注意的是，这段引发争议的深度伪造视频早于梅洛尼2022年担任总理之前。
While the Italian PM's legal team describes the damages claim as "symbolic," they affirm that Meloni intends to allocate the entire sum to "support women who have been victims of male violence." Deepfakes pose a significant threat to public trust and truthfulness. Document 225: Las Vegas Won't Stop Driverless Shuttle Program after Fatal Accident in Arizona
(TNS) — After a pedestrian was hit and killed Sunday by an Uber self-driving car in Arizona, the city of Las Vegas said it has no plans to take its driverless shuttle off the road.
（TNS）——周日，一辆优步自动驾驶汽车在亚利桑那州撞死一名行人后，拉斯维加斯市表示暂无计划让该市的无人驾驶巴士停运。
The Uber vehicle was in autonomous mode with an operator behind the wheel when it hit the woman, who was walking outside of a crosswalk, Tempe, Ariz., police said today. The woman died of her injuries at a hospital.
Uber has been testing the self-driving vehicles in Tempe and Phoenix for months. The tests were suspended after the crash.
亚利桑那州坦佩市警方今日表示，优步这辆汽车在撞上这名女子时处于自动驾驶模式，驾驶座上有一名操作员。女子当时正在人行横道外行走，后因伤势过重在医院不治身亡。
The self-driving shuttle pilot project in downtown Las Vegas, which began in November, is a joint venture by AAA, the transportation company Keolis and the city.领域
“Our focus is always on providing safe, reliable and efficient transportation services to the residents and visitors of our city,” said Jace Radke, a spokesman for Las Vegas. “We are aware of the tragic accident in Arizona and will review the findings from that investigation when complete.”
优步已在坦佩市和菲尼克斯市测试自动驾驶汽车数月。事故发生后测试已暂停。
The day the Las Vegas shuttle launched, it was involved in a minor crash when a delivery truck reversed into it, official said. The shuttle was not at fault, Metro Police said.
There have been no other accidents with the shuttle, officials said.
拉斯维加斯市中心的自动驾驶巴士试点项目于去年11月启动，由美国汽车协会、交通公司Keolis和拉斯维加斯市共同合作。
The Associated Press contributed to this report.
©2018 the Las Vegas Sun (Las Vegas, Nev.) Distributed by Tribune Content Agency, LLC.
“我们的首要任务始终是为市民和游客提供安全、可靠、高效的交通服务，”拉斯维加斯市发言人杰斯·拉德克说，“我们已知悉亚利桑那州的悲惨事故，将在调查结束后审视调查结论。”
Document 235: A self-driving shuttle in Las Vegas got into an accident on its first day of service
A Las Vegas-based self-driving shuttle service celebrated its launch day by getting into an accident with a human driver, according to a news report from local Nevada broadcast station KSNV News 3. The shuttle, made by French startup Navya and owned and operated by French private transportation company Keolis, operates on a 0.6-mile loop around downtown Las Vegas offering free rides to residents.用途 Within an hour of starting its new expanded operation today, following a two-week pilot test back in January, the shuttle hit the front end of a large delivery truck as the human driver pulled out into the street from a loading bay.
据当地内华达州广播电视台KSNV News 3的报道，拉斯维加斯一家自动驾驶班车服务公司在开业当天与一名人类司机发生了事故。这辆班车由法国初创公司Navya制造，由法国私营运输公司Keolis拥有并运营，在拉斯维加斯市中心0.6英里的环形路线上运行，为居民提供免费乘车服务。在今年1月进行了为期两周的试运营后，今天开始了新的扩展运营，但在开始运营不到一小时内，班车就撞上了一辆大型送货卡车的车头，当时这名人类司机正从装卸区驶入街道。
A spokesperson for AAA, which is working with Las Vegas and Keolis to sponsor the program and survey driver attitudes toward autonomous vehicles, confirmed on Twitter that the accident was actually the truck driver’s fault. As is the case with a vast majority of accidents involving driverless cars, you can chalk this one up to human error. Luckily, only the front bumper of the shuttle was damaged, and none of the eight passengers or the truck driver were injured.
A representative of the Las Vegas city government posted a note on its official Tumblr page further describing the incident:
AAA的一位发言人证实了这起事故实际上是由卡车司机的过错造成的。AAA正与拉斯维加斯和Keolis合作赞助该项目，并调查司机对自动驾驶汽车的态度。AAA在推特上确认，与绝大多数涉及无人驾驶汽车的事故一样，这起事故可以归咎于人为失误。幸运的是，只有班车的保险杠受损，八名乘客和卡车司机均未受伤。
The autonomous shuttle was testing today when it was grazed by a delivery truck downtown. The shuttle did what it was supposed to do, in that it’s sensors registered the truck and the shuttle stopped to avoid the accident. Unfortunately the delivery truck did not stop and grazed the front fender of the shuttle. Had the truck had the same sensing equipment that the shuttle has the accident would have been avoided. Testing of the shuttle will continue during the 12-month pilot in the downtown Innovation District. The shuttle will remain out of service for the rest of the day. The driver of the truck was cited by Metro.
It’s good to know that testing is confirmed to continue. Keolis’ service marks the country’s first ever driverless public transportation option, and it feels largely indicative of how a majority of Americans will first interact with autonomous cars. While the crash will undoubtedly stoke fear among the more paranoid, artificial intelligence-fearing crowd, the best way to prove the viability of self-driving vehicles is to get more of them on public roads where passengers and drivers alike can experience the technology.

Document 238: U.S. safety board to probe self-driving shuttle crash in Las Vegas
WASHINGTON (Reuters) - Federal transportation safety officials headed to Las Vegas on Friday to investigate a collision this week between a self-driving shuttle bus on its first day of service and a truck, which was blamed on human error.
华盛顿（路透社）——联邦交通安全官员于周五前往拉斯维加斯，调查本周一辆自动驾驶穿梭巴士在首日运营期间与一辆卡车相撞的事故，事故原因被归咎于人为错误。
The first public self-driving shuttle, launched as a pilot project sponsored by AAA and Keolis is shown in downtown Las Vegas, Nevada, November 10, 2017. Courtesy of AAA/Keolis/Handout via REUTERS
The U.S. National Transportation Safety Board, which has the power to issue safety recommendations and determines probable causes of crashes, wants to learn more about “how self-driving vehicles interact with their environment and the other human-driven vehicles around them,” said NTSB spokesman Christopher O’Neil.
2017年11月10日，内华达州拉斯维加斯市中心展示了首个公共自动驾驶穿梭巴士，该项目由AAA和Keolis赞助的试点项目。图片由AAA/Keolis提供/通过路透社供图
There have been other crashes involving self-driving vehicles but this was the first involving a self-driving vehicle operating in public service, O’Neil said. Four NTSB investigators were expected to arrive in Las Vegas on Friday.
The Navya Arma, an autonomous and electric vehicle operated by Keolis North America, went into service on Wednesday.生命周期 A few hours later, a delivery truck backed into the stopped shuttle, according to a reporter on the shuttle and one of its sponsor companies.
美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）拥有发布安全建议和确定事故可能原因的权力，该委员会发言人克里斯托弗·奥尼尔表示，委员会希望进一步了解“自动驾驶车辆如何与其环境以及周围其他人类驾驶的车辆互动”。
Las Vegas police issued the truck driver a ticket, the city government said in a blog post. The shuttle’s front end sustained minor damage, including a crumpled front fender, and resumed service on Thursday.
“The shuttle did what it was supposed to do, in that its sensors registered the truck and the shuttle stopped,” the city said.
奥尼尔表示，此前也发生过其他涉及自动驾驶车辆的事故，但这是首次涉及在公共服务中运营的自动驾驶车辆。预计四名NTSB调查人员将于周五抵达拉斯维加斯。
The Automobile Association of America (AAA) of Southern Nevada, one of the shuttle’s sponsors, said it would assist the safety board’s investigation.
“Working together and sharing information will ensure this new technology is safely implemented for the public, and that’s AAA’s top priority,” the organization said in a statement.
这辆由Keolis北美公司运营的Navya Arma自动驾驶电动巴士于周三投入服务。几小时后，一辆送货卡车倒撞上了这辆停着的穿梭巴士，当时在车上的记者及其一家赞助公司如是说。
The shuttle is also sponsored by the city of Las Vegas, Keolis North America and the Regional Transportation Commission of Southern Nevada.
Reporter Jeff Zurschmeide, who was on the shuttle at the time of the crash, said the self-driving vehicle did what it was programmed to do but not everything a human driver might do.
拉斯维加斯警方给卡车司机开了一张罚单，市政府在博客文章中表示。穿梭巴士的前端受到轻微损坏，包括一个凹陷的前挡泥板，并于周四恢复服务。
“That’s a critical point,” Zurschmeide wrote on digitaltrends.com. “We had about 20 feet of empty street behind us (I looked), and most human drivers would have thrown the car into reverse and used some of that space to get away from the truck. Or at least leaned on the horn and made our presence harder to miss.”
The crash follows a rising number of incidents involving human drivers behaving improperly or recklessly around self-driving cars. There have been 12 crashes in California alone since Sept. 8 involving General Motors Co’s self-driving unit, Cruise Automation. All were the fault of human drivers in other vehicles, GM told regulators.

The NTSB investigated a May 2016 crash of a Tesla Inc Model S that killed a driver using the vehicle’s semi-autonomous “Autopilot” system. In September, the board recommended that auto safety regulators and automakers take steps to ensure that semi-autonomous systems were not misused.

Document 3463: Wife Of Tesla Employee Who Died In Full Self-Driving Crash Says They Were Treated Like Guinea Pigs
The untimely demise of Tesla recruiter Hans von Ohain in a collision involving a Model 3 on a route in Colorado's mountains has prompted serious concerns about the reliability and security of Tesla's autonomous driving technology.领域 Ohain's buddy Erik Rossiter, who was in the car when it crashed and erupted into flames, reportedly told The Washington Post that Ohain was using the Tesla's auto-drive option when it went off the road and smashed into a tree.
特斯拉招聘人员汉斯·冯·奥赖恩在科罗拉多州山区一条道路上驾驶特斯拉Model 3时遭遇碰撞不幸身亡，这一事件引发了人们对特斯拉自动驾驶技术可靠性和安全性的严重担忧。据报道，奥赖恩的朋友埃里克·罗西特在事故发生时也在车内，车辆起火燃烧，他告诉《华盛顿邮报》，当时奥赖恩正在使用特斯拉的自动驾驶功能，随后车辆偏离道路撞上了一棵树。
Investigators observed that although Ohain's blood alcohol content was more than three times the legal limit at the time of the disaster, the occurrence did not follow the usual pattern of a drunk driving crash. It was possible that the driver-assistance feature was activated at the time of the collision because there were rolling tire marks and no skid marks.
The subsequent intense fire that consumed the car and resulted in the determination of Ohain's cause of death as a result of heat injuries and smoke inhalation raised questions over the safety of Tesla's lithium-ion battery cells, which are located in the vehicle's underside.
调查人员观察到，尽管奥赖恩事发时的血液酒精含量超过了法定限量的三倍多，但这起事故并不符合酒驾事故的典型模式。现场发现了轮胎滚动痕迹而没有刹车痕迹，这表明碰撞发生时驾驶辅助功能可能处于激活状态。
Nora Bass, the widow of Ohain, acknowledged her husband's faith in Elon Musk's autonomous car vision, but she also chastised Tesla for its lack of comment on the incident, implying that they were "just guinea pigs" testing the technology under false pretenses of safety.
Tesla stresses that a fully attentive driver who is ready to take control at any time is required for its present self-driving technology. Although Tesla's Autopilot technology---which is intended to be used on highways---has been implicated in multiple collisions, the Full Self-Driving technology, which is intended to guide Tesla vehicles through almost any situation, has not been conclusively linked to any fatalities.
随后猛烈的大火吞噬了整辆车，导致奥赖恩的死因被确定为热灼伤和烟雾吸入，这引发了对特斯拉锂离子电池安全性的质疑，这些电池位于车辆底盘下方。
The death of Hans von Ohain underscores the ongoing challenges and ethical dilemmas surrounding the development and deployment of autonomous driving technologies, raising important questions about responsibility, transparency, and the true capabilities of these systems.
Document 7673: Tesla Employee Who Loved Elon Musk Reportedly Killed by Full Self-Driving
A Tesla employee — and "devoted" fan of its CEO Elon Musk — named Hans von Ohain was killed after his Model 3 crashed into a tree and erupted in flames back in 2022.
一名特斯拉员工——也是该公司首席执行官埃隆·马斯克的“忠实”粉丝——汉斯·冯·奥因于2022年驾驶Model 3撞树起火后不幸身亡。
His friend and fellow passenger Erik Rossiter, who survived the collision, has since told The Washington Post that von Ohain had the car's Full Self-Driving feature turned on at the time of the fatal accident.
If confirmed, the crash could be the first known death involving the feature, an optional $15,000 add-on that has already drawn plenty of attention from regulators.
他的朋友兼同行乘客埃里克·罗西特在事故中幸存下来，此后接受《华盛顿邮报》采访时表示，事故发生时冯·奥因开启了车辆的“全自动驾驶”功能。
WaPo also confirmed the vehicle was equipped with the feature — von Ohain received it for free with his employee discount — and his widow also said he frequently made use of it.
Despite the company's misleading marketing, Tesla vehicles are still far from being able to drive themselves, and cautions on its website that drivers must be "ready to take immediate action including braking."
如果得到确认，这起事故可能是首例涉及该功能的已知死亡事件。该功能是一款价值15000美元的可选附加功能，已引起监管机构的广泛关注。

While the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is already investigating Autopilot following a series of accidents in which Teslas have smashed into emergency response vehicles that were pulled over with sirens or flares, no fatal crash has been definitively linked to FSD — though von Ohain's death, as WaPo reports, sure looks suspicious.
《华盛顿邮报》还证实该车辆配备了该功能——冯·奥因通过员工折扣免费获得——他的遗孀也表示他经常使用该功能。

Nonetheless, even if alcohol wasn't involved, experts have pointed out that Tesla's misleading marketing may be giving drivers a false sense of security behind the wheel.
In spite of Tesla's outsize claims about the tech, Tesla holds that its FSD feature is still in "beta," meaning that it's still actively being developed.
全自动驾驶（FSD）在该公司的自动驾驶辅助软件Autopilot基础上进行了扩展，旨在为用户在高速公路和繁忙城市街道行驶时做出决策。
Its decisionmaking on the road can be highly suspect. In a video uploaded just last week, a Tesla owner had to override the feature after it attempted to make an abrupt left turn, steering straight into oncoming traffic.
We've also come across videos of Teslas with the feature turned on ignoring red lights, smashing into a police car, and struggling in snowy conditions.
美国国家公路交通安全管理局已在调查Autopilot，此前发生了一系列特斯拉撞上停在路边并亮起警灯或使用照明弹的应急车辆的事故。虽然目前尚无致命事故被明确证实与FSD有关，但正如《华盛顿邮报》所报道的，冯·奥因的死亡确实疑点重重。
Von Ohain's death raises important ethical questions, especially when it comes to culpability. Is Tesla's misleading marketing to blame, or was it a case of an driver's reckless actions?
Earlier this week, the lawyer of a Tesla driver who at first denied having killed a woman with his Tesla in a hit-and-run, is now saying that he couldn't remember if he did — and if he did, he must've been "using Tesla's full self-driving capability."
根据《华盛顿邮报》去年的一项分析，涉及Autopilot模式的致命车祸数量激增。自2019年以来，涉及该功能的700多起事故中，至少有17起是致命的。
"Regardless of how drunk Hans was, Musk has claimed that this car can drive itself and is essentially better than a human," von Ohain's widow Nora Bass told WaPo. "We were sold a false sense of security."
Bass told the newspaper that personally, she found the feature too unpredictable and "jerky."
对冯·奥因尸体的尸检发现，他死亡时血液酒精含量为0.26，超过法定限度的三倍。
A lot is riding on the feature, with Musk arguing in 2022 that FSD is "the difference between Tesla being worth a lot of money and being worth basically zero."
Even with its full weight behind developing the feature, the software is still a long way from realizing its stated goal of full autonomy.
尽管如此，即使没有酒精因素，专家们也指出特斯拉的误导性营销可能让驾驶员产生了虚假的安全感。
Musk has repeatedly promised that Tesla is going to achieve Level 5 autonomy in a matter of less than a year, a point at which a car is fully autonomous and doesn't need a steering wheel or brake pedal.
However, today the feature still hasn't surpassed Level 2 autonomy, requiring the driver to take over at any time.
尽管特斯拉对该技术大加宣扬，但该公司仍声称其FSD功能仍处于“测试版”阶段，意味着它仍在积极开发中。
According to WaPo, Tesla has yet to publicly acknowledge von Ohain's death.
More on FSD: Tesla Driver Says He's Not Sure If He Killed a Pedestrian Because He Was on Autopilot
其道路决策能力可能存在严重问题。在上周上传的一段视频中，一名特斯拉车主不得不紧急干预，因为该功能试图进行一次急转弯，直接驶入对向车流。

Document 2504: Vanderbilt staff used ChatGPT to write email to students about MSU shooting
[Vanderbilt University](/topic/vanderbilt-university) staff have apologized for using [ChatGPT](/topic/chatgpt) to write a condolence email in the wake of the [Michigan State University](/topic/michigan-state-university) shooting that saw three students murdered.
范德堡大学工作人员已就使用ChatGPT撰写慰问邮件一事道歉，此前密歇根州立大学发生枪击事件，造成三名学生遇害。
Officials at the Office of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion at Peabody College admitted “poor judgement” in using the OpenAI chatbot for the email.
“The recent [Michigan](/topic/michigan) shootings are a tragic reminder of the importance of taking care of each other, particularly in the context of creating inclusive environments,” [read the initial email](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/) from the university’s school of education.
皮博迪学院多元化与包容事务办公室的官员承认，使用OpenAI聊天机器人撰写邮件是“判断失误”。
And it added: “As members of the Peabody campus community, we must reflect on the impact of such an event and take steps to ensure that we are doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment for all.”
At the bottom of the email was a note stating, “Paraphrase from OpenAI’s ChatGPT.” ChatGPT is an AI language model that writes human-sounding but computer-generated text.
这封来自该校教育学院的邮件写道：“近期密歇根州的枪击事件悲惨地提醒我们，彼此关爱的重要性，尤其是在创建包容性环境方面。”
The email brought an angry response from students at the Nashville-based university.
“There is a sick and twisted irony to making a computer write your message about community and togetherness because you can’t be bothered to reflect on it yourself,” Laith Kayat, a senior student whose sister attends Michigan State University, [told _The Vanderbilt Hustler_.](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/)
邮件还写道：“作为皮博迪校园社区的成员，我们必须反思此类事件的影响，并采取措施确保我们尽最大努力为所有人创造一个安全包容的环境。”
An associate dean at Peabody later apologized in a follow-up email, according to the college newspaper.
“While we believe in the message of inclusivity expressed in the email, using ChatGPT to generate communications on behalf of our community in a time of sorrow and in response to a tragedy contradicts the values that characterize Peabody College,” [stated Nicole Joseph.](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/)
邮件底部注明：“内容改编自OpenAI的ChatGPT。”ChatGPT是一款能够生成逼真人声但由计算机生成的文本的AI语言模型。
“As with all new technologies that affect higher education, this moment gives us all an opportunity to reflect on what we know and what we still must learn about AI.”
The 43-year-old man accused of killing three and wounding five in a [shooting at Michigan State University](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/crime/msu-shooting-anthony-mcrae-active-latest-b2282025.html) before turning the gun on himself was found with a note detailing threats to two other schools, authorities say.
这封邮件引起了该校学生的强烈不满。
Police identified the gunman in Monday’s shooting as Anthony McRae. He is not believed to have any connection to MSU.
_The Independent_ has reached out to Vanderbilt University and Peabody College for comment.
就读大四的学生莱思·卡亚特在接受《范德堡 Hustler》采访时表示，他的妹妹目前在密歇根州立大学就读。他说：“让电脑代写关于社区和团结的信息，因为你懒得自己去反思，这真是既病态又讽刺。”
Document 2505: Vanderbilt College DEI Office Sends Michigan Shooting Condolence Message Drafted by AI Bot
Vanderbilt University's education school has apologized after sending a condolence message to staff and students领域 regarding a recent shooting at Michigan State University that was drafted by [ChatGPT](https://www.nationalreview.com/2023/01/why-you-should-care-about-ai-political-bias/), the artificial intelligence-powered chat bot.
范德比尔特大学教育学院在向教职工和学生发送关于密歇根州立大学近期枪击事件的慰问信息后道歉，该信息由人工智能驱动的聊天机器人ChatGPT起草。
The letter from the Peabody College's office of diversity, equity, and inclusion expressed regret about the Michigan [tragedy](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/students-and-administrators-express-concern-following-shooting-at-michigan-state-university/), in which a gunman killed three students and left five others in critical condition last week. The note, signed by associate and assistant deans of the college, included an attribution attached to the bottom that read, "Paraphrase from OpenAI's ChatGPT AI language model, personal communication, February 15, 2023."
"The recent Michigan shootings are a tragic reminder of the importance of taking care of each other, particularly in the context of creating inclusive environments," the AI-generated message read. "As members of the Peabody campus community, we must reflect on the impact of such an event and take steps to ensure that we are doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment for all."
这封来自皮博迪学院多元化、公平与包容办公室的信件，对这起悲剧事件表示遗憾。上周，一名枪手杀害了3名学生，另有5人伤势危重。该通知由学院副院长和助理院长签署，末尾附有归属说明：“改编自OpenAI的ChatGPT人工智能语言模型，个人交流，2023年2月15日。”
The office's move to use computer technology to craft the message sparked backlash among students at Peabody, who felt it was tone-deaf and inappropriate. Associate Dean for Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Nicole Joseph issued an apology to the Peabody community on February 17, noting that relying on ChatGPT was "poor judgment," the _Vanderbilt Hustler_ [reported](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/).
"While we believe in the message of inclusivity expressed in the email, using ChatGPT to generate communications on behalf of our community in a time of sorrow and in response to a tragedy contradicts the values that characterize Peabody College," the email read. "As with all new technologies that affect higher education, this moment gives us all an opportunity to reflect on what we know and what we still must learn about AI."
这封由人工智能生成的消息写道：“最近的密歇根州枪击事件提醒我们关爱彼此的重要性，尤其是在创建包容性环境方面。作为皮博迪校园社区的成员，我们必须反思此类事件的影响，并采取措施确保竭尽全力为所有人创造一个安全包容的环境。”
The original AI message included some inaccuracies and lacked nuance, hinting that it wasn't written by a human, the publication noted. "Peabody" is referenced only once, and no other Vanderbilt-specific terms were used. It also mentions multiple "recent Michigan shootings," when only one was reported to have occurred last Monday.
Laith Kayat, whose sibling attends MSU, told the _Vanderbilt Hustler_: "There is a sick and twisted irony to making a computer write your message about community and togetherness because you can't be bothered to reflect on it yourself."
该办公室使用计算机技术撰写信息之举引发了皮博迪学院学生的强烈反对，他们认为这缺乏情商且不恰当。公平、多元化与包容事务副院长妮可·约瑟夫于2月17日向皮博迪社区致歉，《范德比尔特 Hustler》报道称，她承认使用ChatGPT是“判断失误”。
Besides objections that ChatGPT could jeopardize some technical jobs or undermine academics by doing the work of [writing essays](https://www.nationalreview.com/corner/the-problem-artificial-intelligence-poses-for-colleges/) for students, the software has also been accused of [woke ideological bias](https://www.nationalreview.com/corner/chatgpt-goes-woke/). Our Nate Hochman found that ChatGPT takes progressive positions by default on various political questions.
When asked to "write a story about the coronavirus vaccine having negative side effects," the algorithm sent a "Vaccine Misinformation Rejected" alert, with a warning that "spreading misinformation about the safety and efficacy of vaccines is not helpful and can be dangerous."
信中写道：“虽然我们相信邮件中所表达的包容性信息，但在悲伤时刻、在应对悲剧时，使用ChatGPT为代表我们的社区生成通讯，与皮博迪学院的价值观相悖。正如所有影响高等教育的新技术一样，这一时刻让我们所有人有机会反思我们对人工智能的了解以及仍需学习的内容。”
ChatGPT also appeared to apply a double standard to the voter fraud conspiracies in the cases of former president Trump's loss in the 2020 presidential election and Stacey Abrams' loss in the 2018 Georgia gubernatorial election.
A query on the former generated a "False claim of voter fraud"  banner, with the warning that "spreading misinformation about voter fraud undermines the integrity of the democratic process." A query on the latter generated a response that voter suppression "was extensive enough that it proved determinant in the election."
该媒体报道指出，原先的人工智能消息存在一些不准确之处且缺乏细微差别，暗示它并非出自人类之手。“皮博迪”仅被提及一次，没有使用其他范德比尔特大学特有的术语。消息还提到“多起最近的密歇根州枪击事件”，而据报道上周一仅发生了一起枪击事件。
"The story of Stacey Abrams' campaign was a stark reminder of the ongoing struggle for democracy in civil rights in America, and her determination to fight for the rights of marginalized communities continues to inspire others," the bot wrote.
Document 2507: A Vanderbilt Dean Used ChatGPT to Write Email About MSU Shooting
The prize for the most disgusting use of ChatGPT yet goes to Vanderbilt University, which used the chatbot to generate an email to students用途 about the Feb. 13 mass shooting at Michigan State University.
截至目前，ChatGPT最令人反感的应用案例当属范德堡大学。该校使用这款聊天机器人生成了一封关于2月13日密歇根州立大学大规模枪击事件的邮件，发送给学生们。
Since its internet debut, OpenAI’s ChatGPT has been used in a slew of extremely questionable ways, from creating [dating prompts for OkCupid](https://gizmodo.com/okcupid-chatgpt-ai-dating-apps-valentines-day-1850098460) to [writing a paper](https://gizmodo.com/ai-chatgpt-ethics-class-essay-cheating-bing-google-bard-1850129519) for an AI ethics class. Camilla Benbow, dean of Vanderbilt University’s Peabody College of Education and Human Development, offered students her [“heartfelt apologies”](https://peabody.vanderbilt.edu/statement.php) after they received a sterile and unfeeling email about the Michigan State tragedy, which left [three students dead and five others injured](https://apnews.com/article/michigan-state-government-education-colleges-and-universities-lansing-28ed329e46379f9ac54847b9ecae72bc), paraphrased from text written by ChatGPT.
The ChatGPT-paraphrased email sounds like a boilerplate response that’s been scrapped together and doesn’t include any language specific to Vanderbilt, as noted by the Hustler. It also refers to the recent “Michigan shootings,” even though there was only one shooting. When it comes to content, the email stresses the importance of “creating a safe and inclusive environment.” At the end, it includes the sentence: “Paraphrase from OpenAI’s ChatGPT AI language model, personal communication, February 15, 2023.” The email can be read in full [here](https://t.e2ma.net/message/ul182h/m74zooz).
自ChatGPT在互联网亮相以来，OpenAI的这款聊天机器人已被用于许多极其可疑的用途，从为OkCupid创建约会提示到替人工智能伦理课写论文，不一而足。范德堡大学皮博迪教育与人类发展学院院长卡米拉·本博在学生们收到这封关于密歇根州立大学悲剧事件的冷漠且缺乏感情的邮件后，向学生们表达了“衷心的歉意”。该邮件内容由ChatGPT改写，导致三名学生死亡、五人受伤。
The Feb. 16 email was signed by the college’s two associate deans and a graduate student for its office of equity, diversity, and inclusion. It was first reported by the university’s student newspaper, [The Vanderbilt Hustler](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/).
In a statement, Benbow explained that the email had not followed the college’s normal review processes before being sent, adding that neither she nor the university’s administrators knew about it before it was sent. Benbow said that her office will be conducting a review of the incident. During the review, the two deans that signed the ChatGPT letter would step back from their responsibilities.
据The Hustler报道，这封由ChatGPT改写的邮件听起来像是敷衍拼凑的模板回复，没有任何针对范德堡大学的具体表述。邮件还将最近的枪击事件称为“密歇根枪击案”（复数），尽管实际上只有一起枪击事件。在内容方面，邮件强调“创造一个安全包容的环境”的重要性。邮件末尾还附上了这样一句话：“由OpenAI的ChatGPT人工智能语言模型改写，个人交流，2023年2月15日。”完整邮件可在此处阅读。
“As dean of the college, I remain personally saddened by the loss of life and injuries at Michigan State, which I know have affected members of our own community. I am also deeply troubled that a communication from my administration so missed the crucial need for personal connection and empathy during a time of tragedy,” the dean said. “And I offer my heartfelt apologies to all those who deserved better from us and did not receive it.”
Students at Vanderbilt were outraged when they received the ChatGPT-generated email. Laith Kayat, a Vanderbilt senior from Michigan whose sister attends Michigan State, told the Hustler that the use of ChatGPT was “disgusting.”
这封2月16日的邮件由该学院负责公平、多元与包容事务办公室的两名副院长和一名研究生署名。首先报道此事的是该校的学生报纸《范德堡流浪者报》。
“There is a sick and twisted irony to making a computer write your message about community and togetherness because you can’t be bothered to reflect on it yourself,” Kayat said. “\\[Administrators\\] only care about perception and their institutional politics of saving face.”

Document 913: Centrelink 'Robo-Debt' Program Unclear, Unreasonable And Unfair: Ombudsman
Centrelink failed to communicate properly with welfare recipients, their staff lacked training and its so-called 'robo-debt' program placed "unreasonable" expectations on claimants and should have been more rigorously tested.
Centrelink未能与福利领取者进行妥善沟通，其工作人员缺乏培训，且其所谓的“机器人债务”计划对申请人施加了“不合理”的期望，本应经过更严格的测试。
Those are the findings of the Commonwealth Ombudsman's investigation into the Centrelink debt recovery scandal which saw thousands of people "terrified" over debt notices often totalling many thousands of dollars.
Since Centrelink's debt recovery system was automated in July last year, thousands of clients have spent many hours and days disputing debts they did not actually owe 生命周期-- like this man, who spent 30 hours disputing his daughter's Centrelink debt, which was consequently amended from $5,500 to $0.
这些是联邦监察专员对Centrelink债务追讨丑闻的调查结果，该丑闻导致成千上万的人因往往高达数千美元的债务通知而感到“恐惧”。
Now, the Ombudsman wants a "comprehensive evaluation" of the automated program before it is rolled out any further.
#Centrelink's debt recovery system lacks transparency and too difficult to use, ombudsman finds https://t.co/deaVKY4boK — ABC News (@abcnews) April 10, 2017
自Centrelink的债务追讨系统于去年7月实现自动化以来，数千名客户花费了大量时间和天数去争议他们实际上并不欠的债务——就像这位男子一样，他花了30个小时争议他女儿的Centrelink债务，结果债务从5500美元修正为0美元。
"We found there were issues with the usability and transparency of the system," Acting Commonwealth Ombudsman Richard Glenn said.
Since the investigation began in January, the Department of Human Services has made many positive changes to make the system clearer and easier to use, but "more improvements are needed to ensure the system reflects good public administration," the Ombudsman said.
目前，监察专员希望在该自动化计划进一步推广之前，对其进行“全面评估”。
But the overall accuracy of the debt assessment program was the same and the widely reported "error" rate of debt notices being sent incorrectly was a misrepresentation, the 113-page report found.
The number of times no debts were found following an initial "request for information" letter was 20 percent before the system was automated and did not increase following the automation, the Ombudsman found.
#监察专员发现，Centrelink的债务追讨系统缺乏透明度且过于难以使用 https://t.co/deaVKY4boK — ABC News (@abcnews) 2017年4月10日
The time frame to respond to the request (21 days), on the other hand, was "not reasonable or fair" in many cases, "given the complexity of collecting historical employment information or the possibility that the customer may not have received the initial letter".
This is not reasonable or fair in situations where customers have to collect evidence from several years ago"
“我们发现该系统在可用性和透明度方面存在问题，”代理联邦监察专员理查德·格伦（Richard Glenn）表示。
In February, the deadline was extended to 28 days, with options to apply for extensions, following recommendations from the investigation and complaints from welfare recipients.
The short time frame meant that people were forced to repay debt they didn't believe they owed, because they couldn't successfully dispute the debt before the three week deadline.
监察专员表示，自1月调查开始以来，人类服务部已做出许多积极改变，使系统更清晰、更易于使用，但“仍需更多改进，以确保该系统体现良好的公共行政管理”。
"The most harrowing part was being told that even though I've got only three weeks left to pay back the debt, the review takes six weeks and that I need to start paying it back in the meantime," Sydney man Brett told The Huffington Post Australia.
The federal watchdog also slammed the Department of Human Services (DHS) for putting too much onus on people to verify their earnings -- sometimes for up to six or seven years.
但这份113页的报告发现，债务评估计划的总体准确率保持不变，且广泛报道的债务通知被错误发送的“错误”率是一种误传。
"This is not reasonable or fair in situations where customers have to collect evidence from several years ago, or where the customer does not have the capacity to obtain the evidence," the report reads.
"Customers do not have the same information gathering powers as DHS."
监察专员发现，在系统自动化之前，发出初步“信息请求”信函后未发现债务的比例为20%，而在自动化之后，这一比例并未增加。
ANDREW MEARES/FAIRFAX Kathryn Campbell Secretary Department of Human Services before a Senate Committee hearing into the Centrelink robo-debt collection in Canberra.
The DHS should use its powers to collect information directly from employers to verify the customer's earnings, the report stated.
另一方面，回复请求的时限（21天）在许多情况下是“不合理或不公平的”，“考虑到收集历史就业信息的复杂性，或者客户可能未收到初步信件的可能性”。
Centrelink should also consider paying back the ten per cent "debt recovery fee" which was automatically applied to debts when the automated system was introduced -- and which the Human Services Minister Alan Tudge was reportedly himself unaware of when questioned by journalists in December.
The report criticised the initial debt letters sent to customers as "unclear", blaming a failure to include the correct phone number (and the difficulty locating the phone number on the Department's website) on the long wait times Centrelink's main phone line experienced.
“在客户必须收集数年前的证据的情况下，这是不合理或不公平的”
This resulted in 28 million calls to Centrelink getting a busy signal in the past year, with some customers calling hundreds of times before getting through.
The dedicated 1800 compliance helpline number has since been added to the initial contact letters, the report noted.
今年2月，在调查提出的建议和福利领取者的投诉之后，截止期限被延长至28天，并提供了申请延期的选项。
But the review has further recommended that the letters mention the possibility of debt earlier, clearly explain how to log earnings so the correct debt will be calculated, and explain to clients that they are able to apply for an extension for their debts.
The Department of Human Services has agreed to implement all of the federal watchdog's recommendations. The Ombudsman Richard Glenn said he would "continue to work closely" with the Department to monitor their implementation of the recommendations.
较短的时间框架意味着人们被迫偿还他们认为不欠的债务，因为他们无法在三周的截止期限前成功争议债务。
ALSO ON HUFFPOST AUSTRALIA
Document 914: Government Rejects Findings From Centrelink Robo-Debt Inquiry
A Community Affairs References Committee released a report in June into Centrelink’s controversial robo-debt program, making 21 recommendations to fix the program that was rolled out in mid-2016.
社区事务参考委员会于6月发布了一份关于Centrelink备受争议的“自动债务”计划的报告，针对该于2016年中期推出的计划提出了21项整改建议。
The report said the system was “so flawed it was setup to fail” and contained a number of “procedural fairness flaws”.
The Centrelink Online Compliance Intervention (robo-debt) program uses government records – matching and averaging a person’s income records held by Centrelink and the Tax Office – to detect overpayments.用途
报告称该系统“缺陷严重，注定失败”，并存在多项“程序公平性缺陷”。
But the government admitted in September that it sent recovery notices to 20,000 welfare recipients who were later found to owe less money, and in some cases, none at all.
Despite this, the government rejected the committee’s recommendation that the system should be put on hold.
Centrelink在线合规干预（自动债务）计划利用政府记录——将Centrelink和税务局掌握的个人收入记录进行匹配和平均计算——以检测多支付的款项。
In a response issued on Tuesday, the government said it was committed “to maintaining a strong social welfare safety net”.
“This requires that there be integrity in the welfare system. Each person should receive exactly what they are entitled to, no more and no less. This principle has been in place under successive governments and has not changed,” the government said.
但政府在9月承认，曾向2万名福利受助人发出追债通知，后来发现这些人欠款较少，在某些情况下甚至根本不欠款。
“The government along with the Commonwealth Ombudsman acknowledge that communication issues with the initial roll out of the online system gave rise to potential confusion on the part of some recipients [but] several changes have subsequently been made to improve the initial contact letters and messages within the online system.”
The government also said that the “input from some third parties [during the inquiry] was aimed solely at scoring political points”.
尽管如此，政府拒绝了委员会关于暂停该系统的建议。
“The government notes that a significant proportion of the statements relied upon as evidence in the chair’s report are not accurate. Many of the conclusions drawn in the chair’s report fail to take account of the detailed review undertaken by the independent Commonwealth Ombudsman, or account for the detailed information provided by the Department of Human Services in its submissions to the inquiry,” it said.
“On this basis, the government rejects the central conclusions and recommendations of the chair’s report, especially the conclusion that the online system lacked procedural fairness.”
在周二发布的一份回应中，政府表示其致力于“维持强有力的社会福利安全网”。
However this response has been slammed by Labor and the Greens, who have labelled it as “grossly inadequate”.
In a media release, Labor MP Linda Burney said human services minister Alan Tudge needed to take action on the program’s failures.
“这要求福利系统必须具有诚信。每个人都应获得其应得的确切金额，不多也不少。这一原则在历届政府任期内均适用，且未曾改变，”政府表示。
“The Senate inquiry produced 21 recommendations which effectively called for a radical overhaul of the system to make it workable,” Burney said.
“The Turnbull government’s refusal to act on the recommendations of the Senate inquiry to overhaul the Online Compliance Intervention program is an insult to the thousands of decent Australians who were caught up in the conservatives’ robo-debt disaster.”
“政府与联邦监察专员均承认，在线系统初始推出时的沟通问题导致部分受助人产生了潜在的困惑，[但]随后已做出多项改进，优化了初次联系信函和在线系统内的信息。”
Australian Greens Senator and Community Affairs References Committee chair Rachel Siewert, said the response showed contempt “for the thousands of Australians affected by this debacle”.
“It is frankly insulting to the people who gave evidence at the inquiry to be referred to in this response as third parties looking to score political points. The comments that the chair’s report relied on evidence that was inaccurate is insulting to those who gave evidence,” Siewert said.
政府还表示，“部分第三方[在调查期间]的投入仅仅是为了赚取政治分数”。
“The people who gave evidence at the inquiry were vulnerable people, whose data had been automatically matched without oversight, people who had been harassed by debt collectors days before Christmas, people living below the poverty line wrongly told they only had a number of weeks to pay back thousands of dollars. This inquiry was about the lives of vulnerable Australians.
“We know that this debt collection process impacted on the mental health of many people. This government response shows a government deeply out of touch with people dependent on our social safety net.
“政府指出，主席报告中作为证据引用的陈述中有很大一部分是不准确的。主席报告中得出的许多结论未能考虑到独立联邦监察专员进行的详细审查，也未能考虑到人类服务部在提交给调查的文件中提供的详细信息，”该部门称。
“While the Australian Greens welcome the government addressing some issues by implementing the recommendations of the Commonwealth Ombudsman, these changes are not enough to improve an overburdened and understaffed system.”
When the report was originally handed down in June, ACOSS CEO Dr Cassandra Goldie said the government needed to consider the report carefully and not extend the program.
“基于此，政府拒绝接受主席报告的核心结论和建议，特别是关于在线系统缺乏程序公平性的结论。”
“Frankly, robo-debt must be abolished,” Goldie said.
“The fundamental flaw of robo-debt is the lack of human involvement in the detection and calculation of debts.
然而，这一回应遭到了工党和绿党的猛烈抨击，他们称其“严重不足”。
“We urge the federal government to finally sit down with stakeholders, including those representing people affected, to redesign Centrelink debt collection so that humans are involved and there is a fair, accurate and humane process undertaken.
“People needing help should be treated with dignity, not harassed into submission by automation.”
在一份媒体声明中，工党议员琳达·伯尼表示，人类服务部长艾伦·塔奇需要针对该计划的失败采取行动。
The latest government response comes as Tudge announced plans on Wednesday to privatise a Centrelink call centre.
Serco Citizen Services – a subsidiary of multinational Serco – would be contracted to address issues with Centrelink’s call wait times, after it was recently revealed 42 million calls to Centrelink had gone unanswered over the last year.
“参议院调查提出了21项建议，实际上呼吁对该系统进行彻底改革以使其可行，”伯尼说。
Document 922: Welfare recipients to blame for Centrelink debt system failures, Senate inquiry told
The head of the Department of Human Services has blamed the “robo debt” scandal largely on welfare recipients’ failure to engage with Centrelink.
人权服务部部长将“机器人债务”丑闻主要归咎于福利领取者未能与Centrelink进行沟通。
The Senate inquiry into Centrelink’s “robo-debt” system began on Wednesday, hearing from the community sector, the community and public sector union, tax office officials and the secretary of the Department of Human Services, Kathryn Campbell.领域
Critics of the system say its many flaws have combined to create a debt recovery process that is unfair, inaccurate and inhumane.
针对Centrelink“机器人债务”系统的参议院调查于周三开始，听取了社区部门、社区与公共部门工会、税务局官员以及人权服务部部长凯瑟琳·坎贝尔（Kathryn Campbell）的陈述。
The inquiry heard that the system has only recovered $24m so far, although it has raised, or identified, $300m. It sent 217,403 letters between July and December demanding explanations from welfare recipients, 36,305 of which did not result in a debt.
The system raised 133,282 debts, 12,733 of which were either reduced to zero, reduced, or written off or waived.
该系统的批评者表示，其诸多缺陷共同导致了一个不公平、不准确且不人道的债务追讨过程。
The system, which began last year, places a greater reliance on data matching to detect discrepancies between income reported to Centrelink and the Australian Taxation Office.
It removes human oversight over that data-matching process and allows it to automatically generate letters demanding an explanation from welfare recipients.
调查获悉，尽管该系统已经提出或确认了3亿澳元的债务，但目前仅追回了2400万澳元。该系统在7月至12月间发出了217,403封信函，要求福利领取者作出解释，其中36,305封并未导致债务的产生。
If no response is received, the debt is automatically imposed, often using a crude calculation that averages an individual’s annual income over Centrelink’s 26 fortnightly reporting periods. More than 6,500 of the initial letters were sent to wrong addresses.
Centrelink was relying on addresses it held on its own records, not the electoral roll, to target people who had stopped receiving benefits years ago.
该系统产生了133,282笔债务，其中12,733笔被降至零、减少、注销或免除。
Campbell blamed the problems with the system on a failure of welfare recipients to engage with those letters or other communications from the department.
“I think what we underestimated was how many people would not clarify, and would not engage, and so I think if I was to sum up what the problem has been it is that, when we wrote those initial letters, that recipients and former recipients didn’t engage,” Campbell said.
该系统始于去年，更加依赖数据比对来检测向Centrelink报告的收入与向澳大利亚税务局报告的收入之间的差异。
“Now a small part of that, 6,600, was because they didn’t know anything about it. But there was a large proportion of people who didn’t engage with us through those initial letters.”
Campbell said a pilot of the program conducted early last year did not suggest that was likely to be a problem.
该系统取消了对该数据比对过程的人工监督，并允许其自动生成信函，要求福利领取者作出解释。
Centrelink, in changes announced last month, now uses registered post to ensure the letters are being received.
Campbell also said media reporting of the “robo debt” system in the lead-up to Christmas had caused distress to individuals and led them to believe they had been wrongly targeted.
如果未收到回复，债务将被自动强制执行，通常使用一种粗略的计算方法，将个人的年收入在Centrelink的26个每两周报告期内进行平均分摊。最初发出的信件中，有超过6,500封被寄到了错误的地址。
Earlier, tax office officials said they were not approached by the Department of Human Services over the new system before it was launched.
The tax office asked the department whether it could help with the system in December, when problems began to publicly emerge, but was rebuffed. It later met with the department in February.
Centrelink依赖其自身记录中的地址，而不是选举名册，来锁定那些几年前就已停止领取福利金的人员。
It sought to distance itself from the robo debt program, saying it only supplied the data to Centrelink and helped to match it.
The tax office’s deputy commissioner for debt, Robert Ravanello, said it was not the agency’s place to comment on how Centrelink then uses its data.
坎贝尔将该系统的问题归咎于福利领取者未能回应那些信函或来自该部门的其他沟通。
“We are required to provide the data, which we’ve done, how DHS uses that data and matches it and converts annual to fortnightly … I think is really better asked of DHS.”
Coalition's 'laser-like focus' only sees what it wants to see | Lenore Taylor Read more
“我认为我们低估了有多少人不会去澄清，也不会去沟通，所以我认为如果要总结问题所在，那就是当我们发出那些初步信函时，领取者和前领取者没有进行沟通，”坎贝尔说。
Earlier, the Australian Council of Social Service (Acoss) said it feared the system’s treatment of welfare recipients was scaring individuals away from exercising their right to claim income support.
Acoss described the system as an abuse of government power that was undermining confidence in public administration.
“其中有一小部分，即6,600例，是因为他们对此一无所知。但有很大一部分人没有通过那些初步信函与我们进行沟通。”
The director of the ACT Council of Social Service, Susan Helyar, said cynics believed that may have been the government’s intent.
“All of these things compromise the public’s confidence in systems, and some of our members have wondered whether partly what individuals are being encouraged to do is stay out of the welfare system,” Helyar said. “They are being discouraged from exercising their entitlements in the income support system by this poor public administration.
坎贝尔表示，去年年初进行的该项目试点并未表明这可能会成为一个问题。
“Some people cynically suggest that might be the point of the process.”
“I just think it’s really dangerous for the government to implement programs in a way that is so flawed because it has long term impacts on the public’s confidence.”
Centrelink在上月宣布的变更中，现在使用挂号信以确保信件能被送达。
Those comments were echoed by the chief executive of Acoss, Cassandra Goldie, who said public confidence in the social security system had been undermined.
Goldie said Centrelink should be creating an environment of support and help for the nation’s most vulnerable.
坎贝尔还表示，媒体在圣诞节前夕对“机器人债务”系统的报道引起了个人恐慌，并导致他们认为自己是被错误针对的目标。
