Combat proven during Operation Desert Storm, Patriot can simultaneously engage multiple targets under the most severe electronic countermeasure conditions. Since Operation Desert Storm, the United States Department of Defense has invested over $3.0 billion to further improve and extend Patriot ground equipment performance.领域
早在第二次海湾战争之前，人们对"爱国者"导弹的可靠性和性能就存在相当大的担忧和质疑。这款由[雷神公司](http://www.raytheon.com/)和[洛克希德·马丁公司](http://www.lockheedmartin.com/)制造的导弹（概述见[此处](http://www.army-technology.com/projects/patriot/)），约40年前作为防空武器开始研发。根据[雷神公司的介绍](http://www.raytheon.com/products/patriot/)：
>
> Multifunction phased array radar, track-via-missile guidance, and automated operations - including man-in-the-loop (human) override - are the key features of the Patriot system. In addition to the phased array radar, a Patriot Fire Unit is deployed with an engagement control station, an electronic power plant vehicle, an antenna mast group for communications, and up to sixteen remote launching stations. Each launcher contains four ready-to-fire Patriot missiles.
> "爱国者"是一种远程、高空、全天候系统，旨在应对包括飞机、战术弹道导弹和巡航导弹在内的先进威胁。在"沙漠风暴"行动中经过战斗验证，"爱国者"能够在最严重的电子对抗条件下同时打击多个目标。自"沙漠风暴"行动以来，美国国防部已投入超过30亿美元用于进一步改进和扩展"爱国者"地面设备性能。
The list of threats is significant here. In fact, the Patriot was hurriedly modified for anti-ballistic missile service in Desert Storm. It was heralded as a great success at the time for its performance against Scuds - particularly in Israel - but later analysis told a different story.
>
The tally of Scuds claimed was, in fact, fictitious. An initial kill rate of 40-50 per cent soon became a mere 5-10 per cent. Worse still, Patriot suffered from a serious software problem which quickly manifested itself with disastrous results:
> 多功能相控阵雷达、导弹追踪制导和自动化操作（包括人在回路中的人为干预）是"爱国者"系统的关键特征。除相控阵雷达外，一个"爱国者"火力单元还配备了交战控制站、电力电子设备车、通信天线组，以及最多16个遥控发射站。每个发射架装载4枚待发"爱国者"导弹。
> On February 25, 1991, a Patriot missile defense system operating at Dhahran, Saudi Arabia, during Operation Desert Storm failed to track and intercept an incoming Scud. This Scud subsequently hit an Army barracks, killing 28 Americans. This report responds to your request that we review the facts associated with this incident and determine if a computer software problem was involved. If so, you asked that we provide information on what the specific software problem was, and what has been done to correct it.
That's the first paragraph of a [1992 report](http://www.fas.org/spp/starwars/gao/im92026.htm) by the Information Management and Technology Division of the General Accounting Office in response to a request by Howard Wolpe, Chairman, Subcommittee on Investigations and Oversight Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, House of Representatives.
这里列出的威胁种类值得关注。事实上，"爱国者"在"沙漠风暴"行动中被仓促改装用于反导任务。当时，它因在对抗"飞毛腿"导弹——尤其是在以色列的表现——而被誉为巨大成功，但后来的分析却揭示了截然不同的故事。
The report's summary conclusion (there are more detailed extracts at the end of this article) states:
> The Patriot battery at Dhahran failed to track and intercept the Scud missile because of a software problem in the system's weapons control computer. This problem led to an inaccurate tracking calculation that became worse the longer the system operated. At the time of the incident, the battery had been operating continuously for over 100 hours. By then, the inaccuracy was serious enough to cause the system to look in the wrong place for the incoming Scud.
据称击落的"飞毛腿"数量实际上是虚假的。最初声称的杀伤率为40%至50%，很快降至仅5%至10%。更糟糕的是，"爱国者"存在严重的软件问题，很快便造成了灾难性的后果：
>
> The Patriot had never before been used to defend against Scud missiles nor was it expected to operate continuously for long periods of time. Two weeks before the incident, Army officials received Israeli data indicating some loss in accuracy after the system had been running for 8 consecutive hours. Consequently, Army officials modified the software to improve the system's accuracy. However, the modified software did not reach Dhahran until February 26, 1991–the day after the Scud incident.
> 1991年2月25日，在"沙漠风暴"行动期间，位于沙特阿拉伯达兰的"爱国者"导弹防御系统未能追踪和拦截一枚来袭的"飞毛腿"导弹。这枚"飞毛腿"随后击中了一座陆军兵营，造成28名美国人死亡。本报告回应您关于审查与此次事件相关事实的要求，并确定是否存在计算机软件问题。如果存在，您要求提供具体软件问题的信息以及已采取的纠正措施。
No surprise then that "since Operation Desert Storm, the United States Department of Defense has invested over $3.0 billion to further improve and extend Patriot ground equipment performance", as Raytheon puts it.
Perhaps, then, it might be reasonable to expect a considerable improvement in Patriot performance during Gulf War II. An [abc news report](http://abcnews.go.com/sections/nightline/World/iraq_gosknotebook030323.html) dated 23 March 2003 tells of Patriot batteries bogged down in sand en route to Nasiriya:
这是1992年总审计局信息管理与技术部门应众议院科学、太空和技术委员会监督与调查小组委员会主席霍华德·沃尔普要求而发布的[报告](http://www.fas.org/spp/starwars/gao/im92026.htm)的第一段。
> Patriot missile systems are made up of a system of delicate electronics susceptible to frequent failures. While stationary in Kuwait, each battery in this unit had almost daily problems that caused the system to shut down. Commanders worried that the combined stress of a long trip and sand in the electronics could render the radar and computers useless by the time they arrived on site.
>
报告的总结结论（本文末尾有更详细的摘录）指出：
> In less than an hour, the Patriot missiles were set up, and it was the moment of truth for the computers and the radar. Everything worked and everyone was relieved. Maybe Patriot systems were made for this, after all.
Not so. On the same day a Patriot battery downed an RAF Tornado returning from a mission over Iraq, killing Flt Lt Kevin Main and Flt Lt David Williams.
> 达兰的"爱国者"电池组未能追踪和拦截"飞毛腿"导弹，原因是武器控制计算机中存在软件问题。这个问题导致跟踪计算不准确，且随着系统运行时间延长而恶化。事发时，该电池组已连续运行超过100小时。那时，不准确性已严重到使系统在错误的位置搜索来袭的"飞毛腿"。
Two days later, a US Air Force pilot in an F-16 fighter was alerted to the fact that he had been targeted by radar. Assuming it to be enemy in origin, he counter-attacked and fired a missile at a Patriot battery, an event [witnessed](http://www.cbsnews.com/stories/2004/02/19/60minutes/main601241.shtml) by embedded reporter Robert Riggs from the Dallas station KTVT: "Suddenly, my whole field of vision is just-becomes white light. We all thought we were under Iraqi mortar attack. We had no idea this is the good guys shooting at us."
>
The [CBS report](http://www.cbsnews.com/stories/2004/02/19/60minutes/main601241.shtml) which contains Riggs' experiences with the Patriot battery makes sobering reading:
> "爱国者"此前从未用于防御"飞毛腿"导弹，也未被期望连续长时间运行。事发前两周，军方官员收到了以色列的数据，显示系统在连续运行8小时后会出现一定的精度损失。因此，军方官员修改了软件以提高系统精度。然而，修改后的软件直到1991年2月26日才送达达兰——恰是这起"飞毛腿"事件发生后的第二天。
> This was like a bad science fiction movie in which the computer starts creating false targets. And you have the operators of the system wondering is this a figment of a computer's imagination or is this real.
>
因此，正如雷神公司所说，"自'沙漠风暴'行动以来，美国国防部已投入超过30亿美元用于进一步改进和扩展'爱国者'地面设备性能"，这并不令人意外。
> They were seeing what were called spurious targets that were identified as incoming tactical ballistic missiles. Sometimes, they didn't exist at all in time and space. Other times, they were identifying friendly U.S. aircraft as incoming TBMs.
Sometimes, as CBS notes, the system realised its error, and sometimes it didn't. Riggs continues:
也许可以合理地预期，在第二次海湾战争中"爱国者"的性能会有相当大的改进。2003年3月23日的[ABC新闻报道](http://abcnews.go.com/sections/nightline/World/iraq_gosknotebook030323.html)讲述了"爱国者"电池组在前往纳西里耶的途中陷入沙中的情况：
> We were in one of the command posts. And I walked in and all the operators and officers are focused intently on their screens. And so you know something's going on here. And suddenly the door flies open, and a Raytheon tech representative runs in and says, 'Don't shoot! Don't shoot!' Well, that got our attention real quick.
On 2 April, 2003 two Patriots downed the F-A-18C of US Navy Pilot Lt. Nathan White while he was returning to the USS Kitty Hawk. He was killed instantly.
> "爱国者"导弹系统由精密电子设备组成，容易出现频繁故障。当驻扎在科威特时，该部队的每个电池组几乎每天都会出现问题导致系统关闭。指挥官担心长途运输和沙尘进入电子设备可能会在抵达目的地之前就使雷达和计算机报废。
Last week's report by UK defence minister Ivor Caplin on the Tornado incident fingered a "system error" as the cause, linked to failure of the aircraft's "identification friend or foe" (IFF) system against a backdrop of of "inexperienced US troops, heavily reliant on technology to make decisions, but lacking crucial equipment which could have helped them identify the Tornado as a friendly aircraft".
>
More specifically, the Ministry of Defence [Military Aircraft Accident Summary](http://www.mod.uk/linked_files/publications/foi/maaszg710.pdf) (PDF) notes that:
>不到一个小时，"爱国者"导弹就完成了部署，这是检验计算机和雷达的时刻。一切正常，每个人都松了一口气。也许"爱国者"系统毕竟是为这种情况设计的。
> 1\\. Royal Air Force Tornado GR4A ZG710 was returning to Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait at 2348 hrs on 22 Mar 03 (0248 hrs on 23 Mar 03 local time) when it was destroyed by a US Army Patriot Surface-to-Air-Missile after being wrongly identified as an Iraqi Anti-Radiation Missile. The aircraft was the second of a pair of Tornados, flying as part of a package of Coalition aircraft, operating during the early part of the war in Iraq. Both members of the crew were killed instantly when the missile hit their aircraft.
>
但事实并非如此。同一天，一组"爱国者"电池组击落了一架从伊拉克任务返航的英国皇家空军"旋风"战斗机，导致凯文·梅恩空军中尉和大卫·威廉姆斯空军中尉遇难。
> 4\\. The Patriot Battery crew were monitoring for Iraqi Tactical Ballistic Missiles when ZG710 was tracked by their system. The symbol which appeared on their radar indicated that an Anti-Radiation Missile was coming directly towards them. The track was interrogated for IFF but there was no response. Having met all classification criteria, the Patriot crew launched the missile, and the Tornado, mistaken for an "Anti-Radiation Missile", was engaged in self-defence. The Patriot crew had complied with extant self-defence Rules of Engagement for dealing with Anti-Radiation Missiles.
How, then, could the Patriot mistake a Tornado for an anti-radiation missile?
两天后，一名驾驶F-16战斗机的美国空军飞行员被警报告知他已被雷达锁定。他以为是敌方雷达，于是进行反击，向一组"爱国者"发射了一枚导弹。这一事件被来自达拉斯KTVT电视台的嵌入式记者罗伯特·里格斯[目睹](http://www.cbsnews.com/stories/2004/02/19/60minutes/main601241.shtml)："突然，我的整个视野变成了白光。我们都以为遭到了伊拉克迫击炮的攻击。我们根本不知道这是友军朝我们开火。"
> Patriot System Anti-Radiation Missile Classification.
>
包含里格斯与"爱国者"电池组经历的[CBS报道](http://www.cbsnews.com/stories/2004/02/19/60minutes/main601241.shtml)读来令人警醒：
> 9\\. The Patriot system identifies hostile missiles through their flight profile and other characteristics, including the lack of an IFF response. The criteria programmed into the Patriot computer were based on the many different Anti-Radiation Missiles available worldwide, and were therefore very broad.
>
> 这就像一部糟糕的科幻电影，计算机开始产生虚假目标。系统操作员们不禁怀疑：这是计算机的想象，还是真实存在的。
> ZG710's flight profile met these criteria as it commenced its descent into Ali Al Salem. The Board considered that the criteria should have been much tauter, based on the known threat from Iraq, and concluded that the generic Anti-Radiation Missile classification criteria programmed into the Patriot computer were a contributory factor in the accident.
>
Regarding the Patriot's operators' role in the disaster, the report notes:
> 他们看到的是所谓的虚假目标，被识别为来袭的战术弹道导弹。有时候，这些目标在时空中根本不存在。有时候，他们会将被识别的友军美国飞机当作来袭的战术弹道导弹。
> Patriot Anti-Radiation Missile Rules Of Engagement.
>
正如CBS所指出的，有时候系统意识到了自己的错误，有时候则没有。里格斯继续说道：
> 10\\. The Board concluded that the Patriot Anti-Radiation Missile Rules Of Engagement were not robust enough to prevent a friendly aircraft being classified as an Anti-Radiation Missile and then engaged in self-defence, and were thus contributory factors in the accident.
>
> 我们在其中一个指挥所里。我走进去时，所有的操作员和军官都专注地盯着屏幕。所以你知道这里发生了什么。突然门被推开，雷神公司的技术支持代表跑进来说："不要射击！不要射击！"这立刻引起了我们的注意。
> Patriot Firing Doctrine and Training.
>
2003年4月2日，两枚"爱国者"导弹击落了美国海军飞行员内森·怀特中尉驾驶的F-A-18C战斗机，当时他正在返回"小鹰号"航空母舰的途中。怀特当场遇难。
> 11\\. Patriot crews are trained to react quickly, engage early and to trust the Patriot system. If the crew had delayed firing, ZG710 would probably have been reclassified as its flight path changed. The crew had about one minute to decide whether to engage. The crew were fully trained, but their training had focused on recognising generic threats rather than on those that were specific to Iraq or on identifying false alarms. The Board concluded that both Patriot firing doctrine and training were contributory factors in the accident.
To add a final twist to this tale, there is the matter of the Tornado's IFF system:
上周英国国防部长伊沃·卡普林关于"旋风"事件的报告指出，事故原因是"系统错误"，与飞机"敌我识别系统"（IFF）的故障有关，背景是"经验不足的美国部队过度依赖技术做决策，但缺少能够帮助他们识别'旋风'为友机的关键设备"。
> 15\\. The Board considered IFF serviceability, potential IFF failures, and aircrew actions relating to the IFF. The Board was able to discount external damage to the IFF.
>
更具体地说，国防部[军用飞机事故概要](http://www.mod.uk/linked_files/publications/foi/maaszg710.pdf)（PDF）指出：
> a. Serviceability. The ground engineering check on ZG710's encrypted Mode 4 IFF was completed satisfactorily pre-engine start, and an RAF Regiment Rapier Missile unit that regularly checked the IFF of departing aircraft did not report the aircraft or log a fault. In line with extant procedures, only Mode 4 was checked on the ground. However, there is no firm evidence that ZG710 responded to any IFF interrogations throughout the entire mission, although there is evidence that the navigator checked the IFF switches at the appropriate times. The Board concluded that ZG710's IFF had a fault and, as an IFF Mode 4 response would have prevented the Patriot Anti-Radiation Missile classification and engagement, concluded that the lack of IFF at the time of the accident was a contributory factor.
>
> 1. 英国皇家空军"旋风"GR4A ZG710于2003年3月22日2348时（3月23日当地时间0248时）在返回科威特阿里·阿尔·萨勒姆空军基地途中，被美国陆军"爱国者"防空导弹击落，因错误识别为伊拉克反辐射导弹。该机是两架"旋风"编队中的一架，作为联军飞机编队的一部分，在伊拉克战争初期执行任务。两枚导弹击中飞机后，两名机组人员当场死亡。
> b. Failure Modes. Following initial investigation, it became apparent that certain power failures associated with the IFF may not be displayed to the crew. The most likely explanation for the absence of an IFF response was that there had been a power supply failure. The Board recommended that further work be conducted to research the failure modes, reliability and serviceability of the Tornado IFF system.
>
We spoke to Theodore Postol, professor of science, technology, and national security policy at MIT, and a vociferous analyst of the Patriot's performance. His [1992 statement](http://www.fas.org/spp/starwars/congress/1992_h/h920407p.htm) to the Committee on Government Operations, US House of Representatives, dissects the missile's failure against Scuds.
> 4. "爱国者"电池组乘员正在监测伊拉克战术弹道导弹时，ZG710被他们系统追踪。雷达屏幕上出现的符号表明一枚反辐射导弹正朝他们飞来。对该轨迹进行了敌我识别查询，但没有得到回应。由于满足了所有分类标准，"爱国者"乘员发射了导弹，这架被误认为是"反辐射导弹"的"旋风"被当作自我防御目标加以拦截。"爱国者"乘员遵守了处理反辐射导弹的现行自我防御交战规则。
His analysis of the RAF report is as follows:
> The facts provided in the RAF Report issued on May 14 raise more doubts, rather than less, about the accuracy of US Army information provided to the UK - and about the technical and operational reliability of the Patriots in Operation Iraqi Freedom.
那么，"爱国者"怎么会将"旋风"误认为反辐射导弹呢？
>
> A careful reading of the RAF Report indicates that the Patriot Fire Unit did not have its imbedded data recorder operating during the shoot-down of the Tornado, which basically means that there is no reliable information about what the Patriot operators saw and how they responded. It is not even clear to me that the IFF Mode 4 on the Tornado failed, as we do not have recorded data from the Patriot unit and can therefore not be certain that the Tornado was properly interrogated as claimed by the Patriot operators.
> "爱国者"系统反辐射导弹分类。
>
>
> In addition, the RAF Reported that the Tornado was mis-classified as an anti-radiation homing missile, which raises very serious and basic additional questions that remain unanswered.
> 9. "爱国者"系统通过飞行剖面和其他特征（包括缺乏敌我识别响应）来识别敌方导弹。编程到"爱国者"计算机中的标准基于全球现有的多种不同反辐射导弹，因此非常宽泛。
>
>
> The only such missile in-theater was the HARM (High-Speed Ant-Radiation Homing Missile) which travels at Mach 2 (roughly 2,000+ feet/sec). The RAF reported that the Patriot crew fired on the Tornado immediately, rather than using an available one minute to further evaluate the nature of the potentially hostile target reported to them by the Patriot computer software - which was known to be unreliable. Since the Patriot unit had one minute to decide whether or not to fire on a target classified as a HARM, this would mean that the HARM was roughly 120,000 to 140,000 feet downrange, or roughly 25 to 30 miles distance when Patriot's were launched. However, we know that the Tornado had to be traveling no faster than roughly Mach 0.8 (800+ feet/sec). Since the Patriot unit fired when they had one minute to assess the approaching target, this suggests that the Tornado must have been at a range of roughly 50,000 to 70,000 feet ( 10 to 15 miles) when the Patriot interceptors were actually launched.
> ZG710在进入阿里·阿尔·萨勒姆开始下降时，其飞行剖面符合这些标准。调查委员会认为，这些标准本应基于伊拉克已知威胁更加严格，并得出结论：编程到"爱国者"计算机中的通用反辐射导弹分类标准是事故的一个促成因素。
>
>
> If the Tornado was in fact at 10 to 15 miles range (as well as at 17,000 feet - according to the RAF report), then this indicates that a subsonic air-supported vehicle was mis-classified as a supersonic homing missile. If this was the case, the Army needs to explain how a subsonic aircraft following pre-established flight-approach rules could possibly have been mis-classified as an anti-radiation missile by the Patriot's artificial intelligence software. The Army also needs to explain why the Patriot Unit was allowed to operate autonomously when it could not directly communicate with its Battalion headquarters, and why the unit was allowed to engage any target under these inherently unsafe conditions of operations.
> 关于"爱国者"操作员在灾难中的作用，报告指出：
We're obliged to Professor Postol for addressing what are some fundamental - and to date unanswered - questions about the Patriot's effectiveness as a weapon.
>
The Patriot has been sold to the armed forces of Germany, Greece, Israel, Japan , Kuwait, Netherlands, Saudi Arabia and Taiwan. In 1999, Egypt received a $3.2bn grant for a military modernisation programme, including the purchase of 3 Patriot missile system fire units. This Autumn, the US will augment its Patriot capability in South Korea with the deployment of two further batteries.
> "爱国者"反辐射导弹交战规则。
But is Patriot the defence panacea its champions claim - or a neurotic and expensive flying turkey?
>

Document 3181: Gayle King fumes over manipulated AI video of her endorsing weight loss company: 'Don’t be fooled’
American television personality Gayle King has [warned her followers](https://www.foxnews.com/media) about the dangers of artificial intelligence (AI) after she became the victim of a manipulated video.
美国电视名人盖尔·金（Gayle King）在成为一段被篡改视频的受害者后，向其粉丝发出了关于人工智能（AI）危险的警告。
A video of King has circulated on Instagram in which she appeared to promote various weight loss products from a company known as Artipet. The sponsored post appeared on the feed of many of the "CBS Mornings'" host's one million followers.

Phone scams are one of the widespread problems around the world, with many cases of call centers in different countries deceiving people. These scammers often impersonate government officials or tech support representatives to manipulate victims into transferring money. Typically, these calls target ordinary people, but Thailand's Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra recently revealed that she fell victim to an AI-driven phone scam. The scammer demanded money from her by using a cloned voice of a well-known world leader and claiming that her country was the only ASEAN nation yet to contribute. The prime minister recognised the fake voice but was shocked by the scam's sophistication, pointing out how the threat of AI-enabled fraud is growing.
According to [_CNN,_](https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/16/asia/thailand-prime-minister-scam-call-intl-hnk/index.html) Paetongtarn Shinawatra did not reveal who the computer was mimicking but said she received a message in a voice identical to a well-known leader.

"The voice was very clear, and I recognised it immediately. They first sent a voice clip, saying something like, 'How are you? I want to work together,' and so on," Paetongtarn told [_CNN._](https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/16/asia/thailand-prime-minister-scam-call-intl-hnk/index.html)
She said she later missed a call from the same number, then received a voice message that cut to the chase: "They sent another voice message asking for a donation, saying, 'You are the only country in (the Association of Southeast Asian Nations) that hasn't donated yet,' emphasising it. I was taken aback for a moment and realised something was off."
据CNN报道，佩通坦·钦那瓦未透露电脑模仿的具体对象，但表示她收到的语音信息与一位知名领导人的声音一模一样。
She said whoever sent the message "probably used AI to take the voice" of the unnamed world leader.

South Korea's Regulator Launches Investigation into Worldcoin Amid Privacy Concerns
Photo by Remon Geo / Unsplash
In a recent development that highlights the growing concerns around data privacy in the digital age, South Korea's Personal Information Protection Committee has initiated an investigation into Worldcoin, a project that has raised eyebrows globally for its data collection practices. The investigation was prompted by a series of complaints alleging that Worldcoin has been collecting sensitive information from users, including biometric data.
Worldcoin, known for its ambitious goal of creating a global digital identity through iris scanning technology, has come under scrutiny in several countries for the legality of its operations.用途 The South Korean regulator's decision to investigate comes in the wake of concerns about the project's data handling practices, especially the collection of facial and iris information from individuals at ten locations across South Korea.
The investigation aims to thoroughly analyze Worldcoin's activities, focusing on the processing of personal data to identify any potential violations of privacy laws. This move by the South Korean authority underscores the increasing vigilance of regulatory bodies worldwide in protecting personal information amidst the rapid advancement of technology.
Notably, in July 2023, the same regulatory body fined OpenAI, a company closely associated with Worldcoin's founder Sam Altman, 3.6 million Korean won (approximately $2700) for a data breach that exposed information about 687 citizens through the AI application ChatGPT. This incident has further fueled concerns about the handling of personal information by tech entities.
The news of the investigation has had a slight impact on the value of Worldcoin's token (WLD), which saw a 4.7% decrease in value over the past week, trading around $8.15 at the time of writing, according to TradingView. Since its launch in July 2023, Worldcoin has faced regulatory investigations in countries such as Germany, France, the United Kingdom, and Kenya, with Argentina initiating an investigation in August.
In a dramatic turn of events, the Hong Kong regulator conducted raids on the company's offices at the end of January 2024. The regulatory body has expressed suspicions that Worldcoin's management may have violated privacy laws and mishandled biometric data, adding another layer of complexity to the ongoing concerns surrounding the project's operations.
As the investigation unfolds, the tech community and regulators worldwide are keenly watching the outcome, which could set a precedent for how innovative technologies, especially those dealing with sensitive personal data, are regulated and managed. The case of Worldcoin serves as a crucial reminder of the challenges and responsibilities that come with harnessing the power of technology in a manner that respects individual privacy and complies with global data protection standards.

Document 3060: Cruise blames Outside Lands for driverless car traffic fiasco in San Francisco
As many as 10 Cruise driverless cars stopped working in San Francisco’s North Beach on Friday night, causing traffic to back up领域 and leaving some questioning the decision of state regulators a day earlier to approve the expanded use of robotaxis in the city.
周五晚，多达10辆Cruise无人驾驶汽车在旧金山北滩抛锚，导致交通拥堵，也让一些人对州监管机构前一天批准在该市扩大机器人出租车使用的决定提出质疑。
The autonomous vehicles appeared to be stopped in the middle of Grant Avenue, according to social media posts, with hazard lights on, blocking other cars from moving.
In a response to the incident, Cruise said the backup was caused by “wireless connectivity issues” that immobilized the driverless cars. San Francisco police confirmed that the cell connectivity issues were caused by the large number of people at the nearby Outside Lands music festival overtaxing the system.
根据社交媒体帖子显示，这些自动驾驶车辆似乎停在格兰特大道中央，亮着危险报警闪光灯，阻挡了其他车辆通行。
“We are actively investigating and working on solutions to prevent this from happening again and apologize to those impacted,” Cruise said in a statement.
According to a text message exchange between San Francisco Supervisor Aaron Peskin and a Cruise government affairs manager reviewed by the Chronicle, the cell connectivity affected the company’s remote ability to reroute the cell-connected cars. According to Peskin, approximately 10 cars stalled at the intersection.
针对此次事件，Cruise回应称，交通拥堵是由“无线连接问题”导致无人驾驶汽车无法移动。旧金山警方证实，蜂窝网络连接问题是由附近“户外土地”音乐节大量人群导致系统过载引起的。
Peskin said he was told by Cruise that the company is now considering creating its own cell phone network just for its San Francisco operations. It was not immediately clear if the company had plans to improve the connectivity issues for the subsequent days of the Outside Lands festival.
The California Public Utilities Commission on Thursday voted to lift all restrictions for Cruise and Waymo’s full commercialization in the city amid vocal opposition from city officials.
Cruise在一份声明中表示：“我们正在积极调查并制定解决方案，以防止此类情况再次发生，并向受影响的人致歉。”
Transportation and fire officials told state regulators that the spike in robotaxi activity in recent months coincided with disruptive incidents, such as unplanned stops and erratic driving. They warned that such disruptions were likely to occur more often as the companies expanded service.
The road that the cars were paralyzed on was a "tiny street," Peskin said, and there would have been no way for emergency vehicles to get through had there been an emergency.
根据《旧金山纪事报》查阅的旧金山监督委员亚伦·佩斯金与Cruise政府事务经理之间的短信往来，蜂窝网络连接问题影响了公司远程调度联网汽车的能力。据佩斯金称，大约有10辆车在路口抛锚。
"The irony is that this happened the night after the CPUC irresponsibly gave them the green light for unlimited vehicles over the city's objections," Peskin said.
The CPUC's approval did not include a cap on fleet sizes, and [Cruise](https://www.sfchronicle.com/tech/article/cruise-driverless-cars-public-safety-18420223.php) and Waymo are not required to report to state regulators how many driverless taxis they operate in the city.
佩斯金表示，Cruise告知他，公司目前正在考虑为其旧金山业务建立专用的蜂窝网络。目前尚不清楚该公司是否有计划在“户外土地”音乐节随后的几天改善连接问题。
Document 8605: Cruise robotaxis blocked traffic for hours on this San Francisco street
More than a half dozen Cruise robotaxis stopped operating and sat in a street in San Francisco late Tuesday night, blocking traffic for a couple of hours until employees arrived and manually moved the autonomous vehicles.
周二深夜，超过半打的Cruise无人驾驶出租车在旧金山的一条街道上停止运行，导致交通堵塞长达数小时，直到员工赶到并手动移走这些自动驾驶车辆。
Photos and a description of the Cruise robotaxi blockade were shared to a Reddit post on a subreddit about happenings in the city.
关于Cruise无人驾驶出租车封堵道路的照片和描述被分享到了Reddit上一个关于该城市动态的版块。
The cars appear to have been stalled at the intersection of Gough and Fulton Streets.
这些车辆似乎滞留在高夫街和富尔顿街的交叉口。
The mishap comes less than a week after Cruise launched its first fully driverless, commercial robotaxi service in the city.用途 Cruise’s vehicles are initially operating between 10 p.m. and 6 a.m. on designated streets and without a human safety operator behind the wheel. The Reddit post subsequently made the rounds on Twitter.
此次故障发生在Cruise在该市推出首个全无人驾驶商业机器人出租车服务不到一周后。Cruise的车辆最初在晚上10点至凌晨6点之间在指定街道上运营，且车内没有人类安全员。随后，这篇Reddit帖子在Twitter上广泛传播。

Fines for blocking the street sweeper are around $76 per car in San Francisco. The San Francisco Municipal Transportation Authority (SFMTA) did not respond to TechCrunch’s requests for more information about how it handles such situations with autonomous vehicles and whether Cruise will receive any fines for blocking the intersection.
在旧金山，阻挡街道清扫车的罚款约为每辆车76美元。旧金山交通局（SFMTA）未回应TechCrunch的置评请求，即其如何处理自动驾驶车辆的此类情况，以及Cruise是否会因堵塞路口而受到罚款。
The issue calls into question the policy cities need to build around autonomous vehicles when they break the law, as well as Cruise’s own operational protocol for these types of incidents.
这一问题引发了人们对城市需要围绕自动驾驶车辆违法时制定何种政策的质疑，同时也让人对Cruise针对此类事件的操作规程提出疑问。

Document 1539: A Tesla driver who had his car on Autopilot in a fatal crash faces manslaughter charges, report says
A Tesla driver who had his car on Autopilot in a crash that killed two people will stand trial生命周期 on two counts of manslaughter in Los Angeles, Fox Business reported.
The fatal accident in 2019 occurred when Kevin George Aziz Riad, 27, was driving a Tesla Model S at 74 mph in Gardena, Los Angeles.
The Tesla driver, who previously pleaded not guilty, will go on trial for vehicular manslaughter. The case may be the first time a driver is facing a court trial for using semi-automated technology in a fatal crash.
Riad's car went through a red light and crashed into a Honda Civic in a collision that killed Gilberto Alcazar Lopez, 40, and Maria Guadalupe Nieves-Lopez, 39, the report said.
Prosecutors said the Tesla's Autopilot features including autosteer and traffic aware cruise control were being used when the driver crashed into the Honda.
Six minutes before the collision, no brakes were used, crash data showed. But sensors appeared to show that the driver being tried for manslaughter had a hand on the steering wheel, according to a Tesla engineer who testified.
The driver will now be tried on two counts of vehicular manslaughter, according to a Fox 11 LA report. Riad and a female passenger in the Tesla were treated for injuries in hospital.
A number of car crashes have been recorded while drivers used Tesla Autopilot functions, and the first self-driving-related death was recorded in 2016.
The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is examining a dozen crashes that involved Tesla drivers using Autopilot features amid scrutiny over its advanced driver-assistance functions.
Tesla's Autopilot and Full Self-Driving features need "active driver supervision", does not make the car autonomous, and is intended for "fully attentive" drivers, the company says on its website.用途
Tesla did not immediately respond to Insider's request for comment.
Document 9552: Tesla Driver On Trial For Autopilot Crash That Killed Two
Tesla Driver On Trial For Autopilot Crash That Killed Two
It's the first time a U.S. driver is being prosecuted for deaths in a crash where Autopilot was involved.
A judge in California has ruled that the driver of a Tesla Model S on Autopilot involved in the deaths of two motorists must stand trail for manslaughter.领域 This is the first felony prosecution in the U.S. against a driver using a partially-automated system, according to the Associated Press.
It's also the first case involving Autopilot, one of the most widely-available semi-autonomous systems on the market.
State prosecutors believe there's enough evidence to try Kevin George Aziz Riad, 27, on two felony counts of vehicular manslaughter, each carrying a prison sentence of up to six years in California. The prosecutors initially charged Riad in January of 2022, but it was unclear at that time whether the case would proceed to trial.
The case dates back to December 29, 2019, when Riad's Tesla Model S exited a freeway in Gardena and ran a red light. The Tesla was doing 74 miles per hour through the intersection when it crashed into a Honda Civic.
The Civic's occupants, Gilberto Alcazar Lopez, 40, and Maria Guadalupe Nieves-Lopez, 39, died at the scene of the crash. Their relatives later told reporters the two were on their first date that night. Riad and an unidentified woman in the Tesla were hospitalized with non-life threatening injuries.
State prosecutors said that two of Tesla's automated systems were active at the time of the collision: Autosteer and Traffic Aware Cruise Control. A Tesla engineer testified that sensors in the Tesla Model S showed Riad had his hand on the steering wheel for several minutes up to the moment of impact — a safety measure required by Tesla to ensure the driver is engaged while Autopilot is active.
Crash data showed that, while Riad had a hand on the wheel, he had not applied the brakes in the six minutes before the crash. A police officer testified that Riad drove past several traffic signs warning drivers to slow down as they exited the freeway.
Tesla's official reply in such cases is that Autopilot and its "Full Self-Driving" systems can't drive themselves, so drivers have to be prepared to retake control of their cars at any time. But this admonition doesn't fully come across in the way that Tesla's CEO, Elon Musk, talks about so-called FSD.
And the debate over fault and liability when partially-automated cars injure or kill people is still ongoing. It has prompted Congress and NHTSA to look into autonomous vehicle systems in the U.S., while lawmakers abroad try to agree on regulations, too.

Document 1558: Tesla’s Autopilot was engaged when Model 3 crashed into truck, report states
Tesla’s advanced driver assist system, Autopilot, was active when a Model 3 driven by a 50-year-old Florida man crashed into the side of a tractor-trailer truck on March 1st, the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) states in a report released on Thursday.用途 Investigators reviewed video and preliminary data from the vehicle and found that neither the driver nor Autopilot “executed evasive maneuvers” before striking the truck.
美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）在周四发布的一份报告中指出，3月1日，一名50岁的佛罗里达男子驾驶Model 3撞上一辆半挂卡车侧面时，特斯拉的高级驾驶辅助系统Autopilot处于开启状态。调查人员查看了车辆视频和初步数据，发现驾驶员和Autopilot在撞击卡车前均未“采取规避机动操作”。
The driver, Jeremy Beren Banner, was killed in the crash. It is at least the fourth fatal crash of a Tesla vehicle involving Autopilot.
This crash is eerily similar to another one involving a Tesla in 2016 near Gainesville, Florida. In that incident, Joshua Brown was killed when his Model S sedan collided with a semitrailer truck on a Florida highway in May 2016, making him the first known fatality in a semi-autonomous car.
驾驶员杰里米·贝伦·班纳（Jeremy Beren Banner）在车祸中丧生。这是特斯拉车辆涉及Autopilot的至少第四起致命车祸。
The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) determined that a “lack of safeguards” contributed to Brown’s death. Meanwhile, today’s report is just preliminary, and the NTSB declined to place blame on anyone.
Investigators state that Banner engaged Autopilot about 10 seconds before the collision. “From less than 8 seconds before the crash to the time of impact, the vehicle did not detect the driver’s hands on the steering wheel,” the NTSB said. The vehicle was traveling at 68 mph when it crashed. The roof of the Model 3 was sheared off as it hit the truck’s trailer, passing underneath, and then coming to a stop 1,600 feet away.
这起车祸与2016年在佛罗里达州盖恩斯维尔附近发生的另一起特斯拉车祸有着惊人的相似之处。在那起事故中，乔舒亚·布朗（Joshua Brown）于2016年5月在佛罗里达的一条高速公路上驾驶Model S轿车与一辆半挂卡车相撞身亡，使他成为已知的首位在半自动驾驶汽车中丧生的人。
In a statement, Tesla confirmed that series of events. “We are deeply saddened by this accident and our thoughts are with everyone affected by this tragedy,” a Tesla spokesperson said. “Tesla drivers have logged more than one billion miles with Autopilot engaged, and our data shows that, when used properly by an attentive driver who is prepared to take control at all times, drivers supported by Autopilot are safer than those operating without assistance. For the past three quarters we have released quarterly safety data directly from our vehicles which demonstrates that.”
In addition to the two fatal crashes in Florida, Tesla’s Autopilot has been involved in at least two other fatal collisions: the March 23rd, 2018 death of Wei “Walter” Huang in Mountain View, California; and the January 20th, 2016 death of Gao Yaning in Handan, China.
美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）认定，“缺乏安全保障”导致了布朗的死亡。与此同时，目前的报告仅为初步报告，NTSB拒绝归咎于任何一方。
There have been several non-fatal crashes involving Autopilot as well: one from January 22nd, 2018 involving Autopilot, and one from August 2017 involving a battery fire.
Tesla CEO Elon Musk has been criticized for overstating the autonomous capabilities of his vehicles, while also beta testing semi-autonomous features on his customers — with occasional dire consequences. The company sells a version of Autopilot called “Full Self-Driving,” even though drivers are consistently warned to keep their hands on the steering wheel and eyes on the road when operating it. At an event for investors in April, Musk claimed that Tesla would have “a million” self-driving Tesla vehicles operating as taxis by the end of 2020.
调查人员称，班纳在碰撞发生前约10秒开启了Autopilot。NTSB表示：“从碰撞前不到8秒到撞击发生的那一刻，车辆未检测到驾驶员的手放在方向盘上。”车祸发生时，车辆行驶速度为每小时68英里。Model 3在撞上卡车拖车时车顶被掀掉，车辆从拖车下方穿过，最终在1600英尺外停下。
In the past, Musk has blamed fatal crashes involving Autopilot on driver inexperience. “When there is a serious accident it is almost always, in fact maybe always, the case that it is an experienced user, and the issue is more one of complacency,” Musk said last year. “They just get too used to it. That tends to be more of an issue. It’s not a lack of understanding of what Autopilot can do. It’s [drivers] thinking they know more about Autopilot than they do.”
Document 1560: Tesla confirms 'Autopilot' engaged in fatal crash in China
Vehicle maker Tesla has confirmed that one of its electric vehicles involved in a fatal crash in northern China two years ago did have its "Autopilot" function engaged at the time of the crash,生命周期 reports China Central Television (CCTV).
据中央电视台（CCTV）报道，汽车制造商特斯拉已确认，两年前在中国北方发生的一起致命车祸中，涉事的一辆特斯拉电动汽车当时确实开启了“Autopilot”（自动驾驶）功能。
The Tesla Model S crashed into a street sweeper on a highway near the city of Handan, Hebei Province, on January 20, 2016. 23-year-old car driver Gao Yaning was killed in the incident.
The victim's family filed suit against Tesla, blaming the company for their son's death.
2016年1月20日，这辆特斯拉Model S在河北省邯郸市附近的高速公路上撞上了一辆道路清扫车。23岁的驾驶员高雅宁在事故中丧生。
The new revelation would make the case in Handan the first known fatality involving Tesla's "Autopilot" technology. The previously-considered first fatality was thought to have been in the US state of Florida four months later in May, 2016.
Tesla has since stopped using the term "Autopilot" in its descriptions for its Model S vehicles on its Chinese website.
受害者家属起诉了特斯拉，指责该公司对其子的死亡负有责任。

Document 1718: Another Tesla Autopilot Crash Has Wrecked A Model 3 In Greece
Another day, another Tesla Model 3 story – this one could be the first reported Autopilot-engaged crash outside of North America.生命周期
又是新的一天，又是关于特斯拉Model 3的新闻——这可能是北美以外地区首起报告的开启Autopilot（自动驾驶辅助系统）状态下发生的事故。
The Model 3 was in northern Greece with its holidaying driver, You You Xue of California. As with this [fatal Model X impact](https://www.carthrottle.com/post/tesla-defends-autopilot-again-[after-a-fatal-model-x-crash/) and this bizarre incident where a Model S [failed to see a fire truck](https://www.carthrottle.com/post/yet-another-tesla-autopilot-crash-has-been-blamed-on-driver-error/), Autopilot was engaged. Yet again, the driver trusted it too much and paid the price.
While travelling at 75mph (the speed limit), reports suggest that the system became confused by an exit slip-road, jerking away from the straight-ahead lane unexpectedly – and too late for the distracted Mr Xue to prevent it hitting the solid lane divider.
这辆Model 3当时位于希腊北部，驾驶者是来自加利福尼亚的薛先生（You You Xue），他当时正在度假。就像这起[致命的Model X撞击事故](https://www.carthrottle.com/post/tesla-defends-autopilot-again-[after-a-fatal-model-x-crash/)以及这起Model S[未能识别消防车](https://www.carthrottle.com/post/yet-another-tesla-autopilot-crash-has-been-blamed-on-driver-error/)的离奇事件一样，事发时Autopilot处于开启状态。驾驶者再一次过度信任该系统，并为此付出了代价。
In a statement on his Facebook page, he has admitted looking at a navigation app on his phone with one hand on the wheel. After the early end struck his 24,000-mile-plus trip across 25 countries he wrote:
> “My left hand was grasping the bottom of the steering wheel during the drive, my right hand was resting on my lap. The vehicle showed no signs of difficulty following the road up until this fork.
据报道，车辆在以每小时75英里（限速标准）行驶时，系统被一处出口匝道搞混，意外地突然偏离直行车道——而分心的薛先生已来不及阻止车辆撞上实心车道隔离墩。
>
> “As the gore point began, approximately 8m before the crash barrier and end of the fork, my Model 3 veered suddenly and with great force to the right. I was taking a glance at the navigation on my phone, and was not paying full attention to the road.
他在自己的Facebook主页上发表声明，承认当时单手扶方向盘，正在看手机上的导航应用。这场跨越25个国家、行程超过24,000英里的旅程因此提前结束，他写道：
>
> “I was startled by the sudden change in direction of the car, and I attempted to apply additional grip onto the steering wheel in an attempt to correct the steering.
> “驾驶过程中，我的左手握在方向盘底部，右手放在大腿上。在到达这个分岔路口之前，车辆跟随道路行驶没有任何困难迹象。
>
>
> “This input was too late and although I was only a few inches from clearing the crash barrier, the front left of the vehicle near the wheel well crashed into the right edge of the barrier, resulting in severe damage.”
> “当行驶到三角地带起点，距离防撞护栏和分岔路口末端约8米处，我的Model 3突然猛烈地向右急转。我当时正在瞥一眼手机上的导航，没有全神贯注于路况。
He wasn’t harmed and the damage looks a lot worse than the impact actually was. No airbags fired. The video below shows the place where the accident happened.
>
Tesla’s response, a statement [sent to Electrek](https://www.carthrottle.com/out/?url=https%3A%2F%2Felectrek.co%2F2018%2F05%2F25%2Ftesla-model-3-unofficial-road-trip-crash-driver-blames-autopilot%2F), said what we’ve also [been trying to explain](https://www.carthrottle.com/post/car-makers-need-to-stop-using-the-word-autonomous-because-people-actually-believe-it/). Tesla said:
> “车辆方向的突然改变让我受惊，我试图抓紧方向盘以修正方向。
> “Although we haven’t been able to retrieve any data from the vehicle given that the accident occurred in an unsupported area, Tesla has always been clear that the driver must remain responsible for the car at all times when using Autopilot.”
>
Remember: these are not self-driving cars. They can’t be trusted not to have random spasms caused by errant code. Use the sensor array as a driver backup, not a chauffeur.

Document 1867: Robots Ruin Robot Hotel
Hotel owner Hideo Sawada said he wanted to run “[the most efficient hotel in the world](https://www.theguardian.com/travel/2015/aug/14/japan-henn-na-hotel-staffed-by-robots)” by staffing it almost exclusively with robots. According to a new report, however, the hotel has laid off more than half of its bots for being inefficient since its launch in 2015.
酒店老板泽田秀雄表示，他想通过几乎完全由机器人配备员工来经营“[世界上最高效的酒店](https://www.theguardian.com/travel/2015/aug/14/japan-henn-na-hotel-staffed-by-robots)”。然而，根据一份新报告，自2015年开业以来，该酒店因效率低下已裁减了一半以上的机器人。
Sawada told the Guardian in 2015 that he wanted his hotel, Henn na, to have a staff that was 90 percent robotic, but according to [a new report from the Wall Street Journal](https://www.wsj.com/articles/robot-hotel-loses-love-for-robots-11547484628), many of these machines are decorative hunks of metal at best and exasperating at worst. The report, published on Monday, details a number of anecdotes illuminating just how not ready the machines are to take our jobs, and they are especially ill-equipped to smoothly manage a hotel. The hotel started with about 80 robots, growing to 243, of which more than half were later cut.
“When you actually use robots you realize there are places where they aren’t needed—or just annoy people,” Sawada told the Wall Street Journal.
泽田在2015年告诉《卫报》，他希望他的酒店Henn na拥有90%的机器人员工，但根据[《华尔街日报》的一份新报告](https://www.wsj.com/articles/robot-hotel-loses-love-for-robots-11547484628)，这些机器中许多充其量只是装饰性的金属块，最糟糕的情况下则令人恼火。这份于周一发布的报告详细描述了一系列轶事，说明机器离取代我们的工作还有多远，它们尤其不具备顺利管理酒店的能力。酒店起步时约有80个机器人，后来增长到243个，其中超过一半后来被裁减。
One guest complained that he was woken up regularly through the night by Churi, a virtual assistant robot that was put in each guest’s room. The doll kept asking him, “Sorry, I couldn’t catch that. Could you repeat your request?” because it was reportedly activated by the guest’s snoring. “The robot in the room talked a lot, but we couldn’t understand,” [one guest wrote on TripAdvisor in 2016](https://www.tripadvisor.com/ShowUserReviews-g298217-d8432282-r351732111-Henn_na_Hotel-Sasebo_Nagasaki_Prefecture_Kyushu.html). “The robot in our room is irritating,” [another guest wrote that same year](https://www.tripadvisor.com/ShowUserReviews-g298217-d8432282-r442125170-Henn_na_Hotel-Sasebo_Nagasaki_Prefecture_Kyushu.html). “It speaks when we are in a conversation, but it could not help us when when we needed it.”
Churi, which can adjust some room settings and respond to voice commands, reportedly failed to answer some basic questions. One guest in 2017 even tried to call the front desk after “an irate exchange with Churi,” but had to use his personal phone because Churi was supposed to operate as an operator. The little robot dolls were axed.
“当你实际使用机器人时，你会意识到有些地方不需要它们——或者只会让人烦恼，”泽田告诉《华尔街日报》。
Other robots at the hotel included puppy robot dancers in the lobby, of which one guest reported that around half were dysfunctional or dead during a visit in 2016. There were also humanoid concierge robots, but like Churi, they were also removed for being unable to answer basic tourist questions.
Two dinosaur robots at check-in were also reportedly tremendously mediocre in execution, requiring human assistance for menial tasks, like making copies of a passport, an arguably common undertaking for a front desk agent. “Yes there were robots at check in but had problems scanning our non Japanese passports so a human had to assist,” [a guest wrote on TripAdvisor in 2017](https://www.tripadvisor.com/ShowUserReviews-g298217-d8432282-r484304061-Henn_na_Hotel-Sasebo_Nagasaki_Prefecture_Kyushu.html).
一位客人抱怨说，他经常在夜里被Churi唤醒，这是一个放置在每个客房里的虚拟助理机器人。这个玩偶不断问他：“抱歉，我没听清。能请您重复一下请求吗？”因为据报道它被客人的鼾声激活了。“房间里的机器人说了很多话，但我们听不懂，”[一位客人在2016年于TripAdvisor上写道](https://www.tripadvisor.com/ShowUserReviews-g298217-d8432282-r351732111-Henn_na_Hotel-Sasebo_Nagasaki_Prefecture_Kyushu.html)。“我们房间里的机器人很烦人，”[另一位客人在同年写道](https://www.tripadvisor.com/ShowUserReviews-g298217-d8432282-r442125170-Henn_na_Hotel-Sasebo_Nagasaki_Prefecture_Kyushu.html)。“我们在交谈时它会说话，但当我们需要它时，它却帮不上忙。”
The hotel also has robots to carry guests’ luggage, but they apparently only work for a small percentage of the total rooms, can only move along flat surfaces, and are prone to wonking out if they get wet on trips outside.
“They were really slow and noisy, and would get stuck trying to go past each other,” Taishi Mito, a guest at the hotel in 2017, told the Wall Street Journal.
据报道，可以调整一些房间设置并响应语音命令的Churi未能回答一些基本问题。2017年的一位客人在“与Churi发生激烈争执”后，甚至试图给前台打电话，但不得不使用他的个人手机，因为Churi本应充当接线员。这些小型机器人玩偶被裁减了。
While the elimination of more than half of the robots is a staggering amount for a hotel hellbent on operating mainly by, well, robots, that still leaves a number of robots in operation. Though, according to the report, even the ones remaining seem more like glorified statues. “One humanoid figure is propped up at a self-playing piano in the hotel lobby without actually touching the keys.”
Document 1913: Japan’s robot hotel lays off half the robots after they created more work for humans
It turns out that even robots are having a tough time holding down a job. [Japan’s Henn-na “Strange” Hotel](https://www.theverge.com/2015/2/8/8000665/robot-hotel-japan-huis-ten-bosch) has laid off half its 243 robots after they created more problems than they could solve, as first [reported by _The Wall Street Journal_](https://www.wsj.com/articles/robot-hotel-loses-love-for-robots-11547484628).
事实证明，就连机器人也难以保住工作。据《华尔街日报》率先报道，日本海茵娜“奇怪”酒店已解雇了其243名机器人中的一半，原因是它们制造的问题比能解决的还多。
One of the layoffs included a doll-shaped assistant in each hotel room called Churi. [Siri](https://www.theverge.com/2018/10/25/17871898/siri-shortcuts-ios-12-iphone-apple-how-to-best-tips-tricks-search), [Google Assistant, and Alexa](https://www.theverge.com/2019/1/12/18168612/google-assistant-amazon-alexa-smart-home-companies-ces-2019) can answer questions about local businesses’ opening and closing times, but Churi couldn’t. When hotel guests asked Churi “What time does the theme park open?” it didn’t have a good answer. That was a problem because Churi was supposed to help ameliorate the Strange Hotel’s staff shortage by substituting in for human workers.用途
Others on the chopping block:
被解雇的机器人之一包括每间客房内名为Churi的玩偶形助手。Siri、Google Assistant和Alexa都能回答有关当地商家营业时间的问题，但Churi却做不到。当酒店客人询问Churi“主题公园几点开门？”时，它给不出好的回答。这成了一个问题，因为Churi本应通过替代人类员工来帮助缓解“奇怪”酒店的人手短缺问题。
* Two velociraptor robots positioned at check-in were also decommissioned because human workers essentially had to do their jobs for them and photocopy guests’ passports manually.
* Two robot luggage carriers could only reach about 24 of the over 100 rooms in the hotel and failed in rain or snow. They would also often get stuck trying to pass by each other.
其他被淘汰的机器人包括：
* The hotel’s main concierge robot also didn’t know how to answer questions about flight schedules and nearby tourist attractions. It has since been replaced by a human.
Many of the robots that have been retired were in service for years, making them outdated. The hotel decided it was easier to fire them than to replace them, citing high costs. And in the end, a lot of the work had to be left to humans anyway, especially when it came to asking more complex questions. It seems we’re still a little ways off from a completely automated hotel.
* 位于入住办理处的两个迅猛龙机器人也被停用，因为人类员工基本上不得不替它们完成工作，还得人工复印客人的护照。

Document 271: Google's self-driving Lexus cuts off self-driving Audi
Updated 12:15 a.m ET Friday.
更新于东部时间周五凌晨12:15。
Somebody almost had to call a self-driving tow truck.
Two autonomous vehicles, one powered by Google and the other from Delphi Automotive, nearly collided this week in what’s thought to be the first close call between a pair of self-driving cars, Reuters reports.
差点就得叫一辆自动驾驶拖车了。
The Google car, a modified Lexus, cut off Delphi’s modified Audi and forced it abort changing lanes to avoid a crash, Delphi’s John Absmeier told Reuters. Absmeier was a passenger in the Audi at the time of the incident; nobody was hurt in the event.
Delphi has two driverless Audi prototypes on California roads, while Google has 20 being tested.
据路透社报道，两辆自动驾驶汽车——一辆由谷歌提供技术支持，另一辆来自德尔福汽车公司——本周险些相撞，这被认为是首起两辆自动驾驶汽车之间的险情。
The near collision raises important questions about self-driving cars, including who’s responsible when two are involved in an accident.
Update: A Delphi spokesperson emailed Fortune with the following statement: “During a demo drive of our automated vehicle, our expert used the interaction with the Google car as an example of the types of scenarios that the car can encounter in real-world driving. It was an anecdote of an interaction, not a ‘near miss’. Reuters completely misrepresented the facts.”
德尔福的约翰·阿布施迈尔告诉路透社，谷歌那辆改装雷克萨斯切入了德尔福改装奥迪的前方，迫使后者为了避让而中止变道。事发时阿布施迈尔正乘坐在这辆奥迪车上；事件中无人受伤。
Document 275: Google, Delphi Self-Driving Cars Getting Dinged in California
Four of the nearly 50 self-driving cars now rolling around California have gotten into accidents since September, when the state began issuing permits for companies to test them on public roads. Scott Budman reports. (Published Monday, May 11, 2015)
自9月加州开始发放许可允许公司在公共道路上测试自动驾驶汽车以来，目前行驶在加州的近50辆自动驾驶汽车中有四辆发生了事故。Scott Budman报道。（发布于2015年5月11日，星期一）
Four of the nearly 50 self-driving cars now rolling around California have gotten into accidents since September, when the state began issuing permits for companies to test them on public roads.
Two accidents happened while the cars were in control; in the other two, the person who still must be behind the wheel was driving, a person familiar with the accident reports told The Associated Press.
自9月加州开始发放许可允许公司在公共道路上测试自动驾驶汽车以来，目前行驶在加州的近50辆自动驾驶汽车中有四辆发生了事故。
Three involved Lexus SUVs that Google Inc. outfitted with sensors and computing power in its aggressive effort to develop "autonomous driving," a goal the tech giant shares with traditional automakers. The parts supplier Delphi Automotive had the other accident with one of its two test vehicles.生命周期
Google and Delphi said their cars were not at fault in any accidents, which the companies said were minor.

Five other companies have testing permits. In response to questions from the AP, all said they had no accidents. In all, 48 cars are licensed to test on public roads.
The fact that neither the companies nor the state have revealed the accidents troubles some who say the public should have information to monitor the rollout of technology that its own developers acknowledge is imperfect.
谷歌和德尔福表示，他们的事故车辆并无过错，并称这些事故都很轻微。
John Simpson, a longtime critic of Google as privacy project director of the nonprofit Consumer Watchdog, pointed out that the company's ultimate goal is a car without a steering wheel or pedals. That would mean a person has no power to intervene if a car lost control, making it "even more important that the details of any accidents be made public — so people know what the heck's going on."
A chief selling point for self-driving cars is safety. Their cameras, radar and laser sensors give them a far more detailed understanding of their surroundings than humans have. Their reaction times also should be faster. Cars could be programmed to adjust if they sense a crash coming — move a few feet, tighten the seat belts, honk the horn or flash the lights in hope of alerting a distracted driver.
自9月以来，任何事故都必须向州机动车辆管理局报告。该机构表示确实发生了四起事故，但拒绝就过错责任或其他情况发表评论，理由是根据加州法律，碰撞报告属于机密。
A higher priority so far is teaching them to avoid causing a serious accident that could set public and political acceptance of the technology back years, said Raj Rajkumar, a pioneer of the technology with Carnegie Mellon University.
In the October accident involving Delphi, the front of its 2014 Audi SQ5 was moderately damaged when, as it waited to make a left turn, another car broadsided it, according to an accident report the company shared with AP. The car was not in self-driving mode, Delphi spokeswoman Kristen Kinley said.

In a written statement, Google said that since September, cars driving on streets near its headquarters in Mountain View had "a handful of minor fender-benders, light damage, no injuries, so far caused by human error and inattention."
Google said that while safety is paramount some accidents can be expected, given that its cars have gone "the equivalent of over 15 years of typical human driving," or approximately 140,000 miles.

Document 3156: UnitedHealth Faces Lawsuit, Media Scrutiny Over AI’s Role in Medicare Advantage Denials of Nursing Home Care
UnitedHealthcare, a unit of UnitedHealth Group (NYSE: UNH), is facing a federal lawsuit over its use of an artificial intelligence tool in making Medicare Advantage claims denials for patients in extended care facilities.
联合健康集团（纽交所代码：UNH）旗下的联合健康保险公司正面临一项联邦诉讼，指控其在针对长期护理机构患者的联邦医疗保险优势计划理赔拒赔中使用了人工智能工具。
That same issue was at the center of a [recently published](https://www.statnews.com/2023/11/14/unitedhealth-algorithm-medicare-advantage-investigation/) piece in STAT, a health-oriented news outlet.
Aaron Albright, a spokesperson for Optum, the unit of UnitedHealth involved in the lawsuit’s claims, told Skilled Nursing News that the AI tool used in assessing claims is more for guidance and not for denial of insurance claims.
这一相同问题也是健康类新闻媒体STAT近日发表的一篇文章的核心。
“The \\[NaviHealth\\] predict tool is not used to make coverage determinations. The tool is used as a guide to help us inform providers, families and other caregivers about what sort of assistance and care the patient may need both in the facility and after returning home,” said Albright, via an emailed statement. “Coverage decisions are based on CMS coverage criteria and the terms of the member’s plan. This lawsuit has no merit, and we will defend ourselves vigorously.”
The high level of denials were generated because UnitedHealth’s AI tool – one developed by its subsidiary NaviHealth – does not use input from doctors to predict the length of stay for patients in long-term care, according to the Class Action Complaint. Instead, the tool compares a patient’s demographic and medical information against a database of other similar patients, and uses that information to determine how many days United Healthcare will approve a necessary stay at a care facility, the plaintiffs’ lawyers said in a press release. This often “undercuts the amount of time recommended by a physician,” they argue.
联合健康集团涉入诉讼指控的业务部门Optum的发言人Aaron Albright向《专业护理新闻》表示，用于评估理赔的AI工具更多是起指导作用，并非用于拒绝保险理赔。
Upon appeal, the MA denials don’t not hold up once doctors and medical experts review the claims, the lawsuit alleges. In fact, claims denials were reversed in 90% of the cases. That said, the lawyers note that currently, only around 0.2% of patients submit their claims for appeals, with the majority of residents having to pay out of pocket for the rest of their stay at a care facility.
The lawsuit comes after nursing home [providers](https://skillednursingnews.com/2023/08/painful-and-getting-worse-rise-of-medicare-advantage-drains-vast-revenue-from-snf-sector-worsens-workforce-instability/) and [lawmakers](https://skillednursingnews.com/2023/07/astronomical-medicare-advantage-denials-pre-auth-issues-cause-outcry-from-nursing-homes/) have expressed frustration over Medicare Advantage denials by not just UnitedHealth, but other large insurance companies as well.
Albright通过电子邮件声明表示：“[NaviHealth]预测工具并非用于做出承保决定。该工具仅作为指引，帮助我们告知医疗服务提供者、家属及其他护理人员，患者在机构内及返家后可能需要何种援助和护理。承保决定是基于联邦医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）的承保标准以及会员计划的条款做出的。此诉讼毫无根据，我们将坚决为自己辩护。”
And the STAT article points out that NaviHealth is used by other large insurance companies as well. “NaviHealth doesn’t just manage nursing home care within UnitedHealth’s plans, but also serves large Medicare Advantage insurers such as Humana and many regional health plans — potentially affecting the care of more than 15 million people, or half of all Medicare Advantage enrollees,” the article states.
NaviHealth set a target for 2023 to keep rehab stays of patients in MA plans within 1% of the days projected by the algorithm, STAT reported, citing internal documents that the publication obtained. The lawsuit seeks to stop UnitedHealth’s use of AI to replace doctor’s orders as well as get restitution for emotional distress damages, compensatory damages and punitive damages, the law firm’s press release stated.
根据集体诉讼投诉书，之所以出现高比例的拒赔，是因为联合健康的AI工具——由其子公司NaviHealth开发——在预测长期护理患者的住院时长时，并未采用医生的输入信息。原告律师在新闻稿中指出，相反，该工具将患者的人口统计和医疗信息与其他类似患者的数据库进行比对，并利用这些信息来决定联合健康保险公司将批准多少天的必要护理机构住院时间。他们认为，这往往“缩短了医生建议的时间”。
Document 3158: America's Largest Health Insurer Denying Care With AI That's Wrong 90 Percent of the Time, Lawsuit Alleges
UnitedHealthcare, the largest health insurance provider in the US, is using an AI algorithm called nH Predict whose wildly inaccurate predictions are being used to deny health coverage to severely ill patients by cutting the time they can spend in extended care, a [new lawsuit alleges](https://cdn.arstechnica.net/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/class-action-v-unitedhealth-and-navihealth-1.pdf).
一项新的诉讼指控，美国最大的健康保险提供商联合健康保险（UnitedHealthcare）正在使用一种名为 nH Predict 的 AI 算法，其极不准确的预测正被用于剥夺重病患者的保险覆盖，手段是缩短他们在延续护理机构的时间。
The suit, filed this week in the US District Court of Minnesota, was put forward by the estate of two deceased individuals who were denied coverage by UnitedHealth. The plaintiffs argue that the health insurance company should have known how inaccurate its AI was, and that the provider breached its contract by using it.
Their grievances are corroborated by an [investigation from _Stat News_](https://www.statnews.com/2023/11/14/unitedhealth-algorithm-medicare-advantage-investigation/) into UnitedHealth's internal practices at its subsidiary NaviHealth, which found that the company forced employees to unwaveringly adhere to the AI algorithm's questionable projections on how long patients could stay in extended care.
该诉讼于本周在明尼苏达州联邦地方法院提起，由两名生前被联合健康保险拒绝理赔的死者遗产管理方提出。原告辩称，该健康保险公司本应知晓其 AI 的不准确程度，且该提供商因使用该算法而违反了合同。
At least there was a silver lining in the board room: the penny-pinching AI reportedly saved the company an estimated hundreds of millions of dollars it would have been forced to spend on the patients' care otherwise, according to _Stat_.
Though the health claims are rarely appealed, when they are, around 90 percent of them are reversed, according to the lawsuit. That suggests that the AI is egregiously inaccurate, and that by placing undue trust in it, UnitedHealth is scamming countless vulnerable patients out of their healthcare.
《Stat News》对联合健康保险子公司 NaviHealth 内部做法的一项调查证实了他们的不满。调查发现，公司强迫员工坚定不移地遵循 AI 算法关于患者可在延续护理机构停留时长的可疑预测。
"If UnitedHealth is using \\[NaviHealth’s\\] algorithms as gospel... that’s not clinical decision-making," Spencer Perlman, a healthcare markets analyst, told _Stat_. "That’s aggregating data and using an algorithm to make a decision that has nothing to do with the individual themselves."
UnitedHealth fired back in a statement to _Stat_.
至少董事会里还有一线希望：据《Stat》报道，这款吝啬的 AI 据称为公司节省了估计数亿美元，否则这些钱本不得不花在患者的护理上。
"The assertions that NaviHealth uses or incentivizes employees to use a tool to deny care are false," it read. "Adverse coverage decisions are made by medical directors and based on Medicare coverage criteria, not a tool or a performance goal tied to any single quality metric."
Documents and employee testimony seem to corroborate the questionable decisionmaking of UnitedHealth's AI, though.
诉讼称，虽然这些健康理赔很少被上诉，但一旦上诉，约 90% 的拒赔决定会被推翻。这表明该 AI 极不准确，且联合健康保险因对其给予不当信任，正在骗取无数弱势患者的医疗服务。
In one case, the nH Predict system allotted a mere 20 days of rehab for an older woman who was found paralyzed after suffering a stroke — just half the average for impaired stroke patients, according to _Stat_. An elderly, legally blind man with a failing heart and kidneys only received a shockingly inadequate 16 days to recover.
What could be making nH Predict so wrong? It's basing its projections on the length of stays of some six million previous patients in the company's database. On its face, that may appear sound, but that means the AI is inheriting the errors and cost-cutting of those previous decisions — and above all, failing to account for exigent factors both clinical and practical.
“如果联合健康保险将 [NaviHealth 的] 算法奉为圭臬……那就不是临床决策，”医疗市场分析师斯宾塞·帕尔曼告诉《Stat》，“那是聚合数据并利用算法做出与个人本身毫无关系的决定。”
"Length of stay is not some biological variable," Ziad Obermeyer, a physician at University of California, Berkeley, and a researcher of algorithmic bias, told _Stat_.
"People are being forced out of the \\[nursing home\\] because they can't pay or because their insurance sucks," he added. "And so the algorithm is basically learning all the inequalities of our current system."
联合健康保险在给《Stat》的一份声明中进行了反驳。
Yet UnitedHealth would only make its standards more extreme. In 2022, case managers were instructed to keep nursing home stays within three percent of the AI's projection.
Next year, however, it was narrowed to less than one percent, effectively giving employees zero leeway. If case managers failed to hit that target, they were disciplined or fired, according to _Stat_.
“关于 NaviHealth 使用或激励员工使用工具拒绝护理的断言是错误的，”声明写道。“不利的承保决定是由医疗总监做出的，并基于 Medicare 承保标准，而非某种工具或与任何单一质量指标挂钩的绩效目标。”
"By the end of my time at NaviHealth I realized — I'm not an advocate, I'm just a moneymaker for this company," Amber Lynch, a former NaviHealth case manager who was fired earlier this year, told _Stat_. "It's all about money and data points," she added. "It takes the dignity out of the patient, and I hated that."
All told, it sounds like a grim example of how the seeming objectivity of AI can be used to cover up shady practices and exploit people at their most vulnerable.
然而，文件和员工证词似乎证实了联合健康保险 AI 决策的可疑之处。
Document 3160: UnitedHealth Group served class action lawsuit for AI-informed managed care denials
UnitedHealthcare is being sued for allegedly using unreliable artificial intelligence algorithms to wrongfully deny payment for post-acute managed care.
联合健康保险公司（UnitedHealthcare）因涉嫌使用不可靠的人工智能算法错误拒绝支付急性期后管理护理费用而被起诉。
The three defendants named [in the complaint](https://fingfx.thomsonreuters.com/gfx/legaldocs/lbvgoerodvq/Lokken%20v%20UnitedHealth%20complaint%2011-14.pdf) filed Tuesday are UnitedHealth Group, its health insurance segment UnitedHealthcare, and its subsidiary technology firm NaviHealth, which created the AI tool at issue called nH Predict.
The complaint alleges that nH Predict has an error rate of 90%, but UHG continues to use it because only a small proportion of policyholders tend to appeal denied claims for service. The rest either pay out-of-pocket for the denied care or forgo the care entirely, it said.
周二提交的[起诉书](https://fingfx.thomsonreuters.com/gfx/legaldocs/lbvgoerodvq/Lokken%20v%20UnitedHealth%20complaint%2011-14.pdf)中点名的三名被告是：联合健康集团（UnitedHealth Group）、其健康保险部门联合健康保险公司，以及其子公司、技术开发公司 NaviHealth，该公司开发了涉事的名为 nH Predict 的 AI 工具。
“Defendants systematically deploy an AI algorithm to prematurely and in bad faith discontinue payment for healthcare services for elderly individuals with serious diseases and injuries,” the complaint noted. “Defendants also utilize the nH Predict AI Model to aggressively deny coverage because they know they will not be held accountable for wrongful denials.”
Plaintiffs are seeking damages for out-of-pocket costs incurred for post-acute care denied by UHG, emotional distress, attorneys’ fees and demanded a jury trial. They estimated that hundreds of individuals could have been wrongfully denied care because of nH Predict, and more than $5 million is potentially at stake.
起诉书指控称，nH Predict 的错误率高达 90%，但联合健康集团仍继续使用它，因为只有极少数投保人倾向于对被拒绝的服务索赔进行申诉。起诉书指出，其余投保人要么自掏腰包支付被拒护理的费用，要么完全放弃护理。
Some lawmakers have recently drawn attention to Medicare Advantage health insurers’ use of AI applications to deny patients prescribed care. Sen. Richard Blumenthal (D-CT), for example, [denounced the practice](https://www.mcknightshomecare.com/home-care-providers-applaud-lawmakers-scrutiny-of-ma-plan-prior-authorizations/) during a Senate subcommittee hearing in May.
UHG was also accused of relying on results from nH Predict rather than doctors’ opinions to determine whether post-acute care, such as home health, will be approved or denied. As a result, UHG saved money by reducing the labor costs of paying medical professionals to “conduct an individualized, manual review of each of its insured’s claims.”
起诉书指出：“被告系统性部署 AI 算法，恶意提前终止对患有严重疾病和受伤老年人的医疗服务支付。被告还利用 nH Predict AI 模型激进地拒绝承保，因为他们知道自己不会因错误拒赔而被追责。”
And where UHG saves money, taxpayers lose money, the complaint alleges. Oftentimes, Medicare-eligible UHG policyholders are told that care was denied “solely due to their Medicare eligibility,” and are directed to instead enroll in Medicare to receive services, it said.

Document 3384: Don’t Get Scammed By The Ree Drummond Le Creuset Giveaway
A fraudulent online campaign claiming beloved Food Network host Ree Drummond has collaborated with Le Creuset for an epic holiday giveaway has infiltrated social media through manipulated advertisements and questionable external websites. However, the supposed cookware freebie offer intends stealing users' personal and financial information rather than reasonable celebrity product charity. This article exposes the systematic deception strategies such appliance scams employ to financially exploit individuals alongside protection guidance avoiding potential damages.
# 虚假在线宣传活动冒充深受喜爱的Food Network主持人Ree Drummond与Le Creuset合作推出盛大节日赠品活动，通过篡改广告和有问题的外部网站渗透社交媒体。然而，所谓的厨具免费赠品优惠实际上是窃取用户的个人和财务信息，而非合理的名人产品慈善活动。本文揭露了此类家电诈骗采用的系统性欺诈策略，这些策略如何对个人进行经济剥削，并提供避免潜在损害的保护指导。
![Le Creuset Giveaway Scam](https://malwaretips.com/blogs/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Le-Creuset-Giveaway-Scam-1024x504.jpg "Don't Get Scammed By The Ree Drummond Le Creuset Giveaway 1")
Scam Overview
![Le Creuset赠品诈骗](https://malwaretips.com/blogs/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Le-Creuset-Giveaway-Scam-1024x504.jpg "不要被Ree Drummond Le Creuset赠品活动诈骗")
-------------
This increasingly common scam starts circulating online ads run across popular platforms like Facebook and Instagram. These feature deepfake AI video content portraying Ree Drummond enthusiastically explaining an ex生命周期clusive seasonal deal gifting free Le Creuset cookware sets to fans who enter quickly enough:
## 诈骗概述
> *"Hey y'all, Ree Drummond here with some exciting news!"* exclaims the simulated promotional spots. *"To spread some holiday cheer this year, I've teamed up with Le Creuset to give away a few of their gorgeous Dutch ovens totally FREE to some of my most supportive fans and followers!"*
The fabricated Pioneer Woman representation urges viewers act fast through integrated links supposedly revealing voucher ownership details for securing the expensive kitchenwares simply covering minor $10 shipping labels appearing reasonable reconciliation good-cause holiday gestures demonstrating celebrity generosity expecting little reciprocation beyond fair logistic costs in return.
这种日益常见的诈骗活动开始在Facebook和Instagram等流行平台上流通在线广告。这些广告采用深度伪造人工智能视频内容，模拟Ree Drummond热情地向粉丝解释一项专属季节性优惠，赠送免费的Le Creuset厨具套装给足够快速参与的人：
However, users then get rerouted outside social media to various elaborate intermediate phishing websites completely unassociated with Le Creuset or the real celebrity talent.
Decoy portal pages like "cookwareworldusa.com" showcase the Le Creuset logo alongside fake news articles depicting the epic giveaway covered by major outlets. Website headers trumpet unbelievable headlines implying coveted products remain available still if acting quickly enough:
> *"嘿，各位，Ree Drummond这里有一个令人兴奋的消息！"*模拟的宣传视频中说道。*"为了在今年传播节日欢乐，我与Le Creuset合作，向我最忠诚的粉丝和追随者免费赠送一些精美的荷兰锅！"*
> *"Only 8 Free Le Creuset Cookware Sets Left Thanks to Overwhelming Interest from Ree Drummond Followers -- Learn More About Nationwide Giveaway Now Before It's Too Late!"*
This aims overcoming initial skepticism around the scam justifying requests later asking sensitive customer payment and personal data rather than raising red flags over such unbelievable free merchandise requiring so little initial investment.
这个虚构的"先锋女性"代表敦促观众通过综合链接迅速行动，这些链接据称会显示优惠券详细信息，只需支付少量10美元的合理运费即可获得昂贵的厨房用品，这与良好的节日善意相符，表明名人慷慨大方，期待的回报仅仅是公平的物流费用。
After scrolling through fake dwindling inventory alerts and customer testimonials, visitors reach customized order forms promising delivery of the pricey cookware sets solely pending small $9.95 upfront shipping/handling fees appearing reasonable logistics costs reconciliation typical e-commerce voucher-based giveaway promotions.
However hidden subscription clauses discreetly authorize expensive unauthorized recurring monthly charges from shady partners rather than reasonable one-time payments expected under $10 limit disclosed publicly.
然而，用户随后会被重定向到社交媒体外部的各种精心设计的中间钓鱼网站，这些网站与Le Creuset或真正的名人完全无关。
In the end, victims receive no high-end Le Creuset cooking products actually promised long term. But compromised confidential information enables scammers inflicting significant financial damages through underground data sale channels thanks to unlocked credit card or account access carelessly handed over initially chasing extraordinary holiday deals seeming too good ignoring.
How the Scam Works
像"cookwareworldusa.com"这样的诱饵门户网站展示Le Creuset标志以及虚假新闻文章，声称主流媒体报道了这一盛大赠品活动。网站标题宣传令人难以置信的头条新闻，暗示抢手的产品仍然可用，如果尽快行动的话：
------------------
The fraudulent Ree Drummond Le Creuset giveaway conducts highly coordinated strategies luring victims through an elaborate deceptive process preying vulnerabilities even among vigilant individuals:
> *"由于Ree Drummond粉丝的热情响应，仅剩8套免费Le Creuset厨具——立即了解全国赠品活动，错过就太晚了！"*
### Step 1) Build Hype With Deepfake Celebrity Endorsement Videos
The scam starts using AI deepfake generated videos falsely portraying Ree Drummond enthusiastically endorsing the holiday Le Creuset giveaway for fans. Her familiar Food Network personality recognition builds initial social hype and wider reach to amplify fraudulent conversion ratios scaling at unprecedented levels later.
这旨在克服最初对诈骗的怀疑，为后来要求提供敏感的客户支付和个人数据辩护，而不是对这种难以置信的免费商品产生警惕，因为最初只需要很少的投资。
### Step 2) Direct Traffic Through Elaborate External Phishing Pages
Clicking those fabricated endorsement videos and captions sends viewers outside social media ecosystems rerouting victims through polished intermediate portal pages like "cookwareworldusa.com" impersonating reputable brands. These feature more Drummond imagery alongside situational backstories and limited-time promotion details overcoming skepticism at scale.
在浏览了虚假的库存减少警报和客户推荐后，访问者会进入定制订单表单，承诺交付昂贵的厨具套装，只需支付少量9.95美元的前期运费/处理费，这看起来是合理的物流成本，是典型的电子商务优惠券赠品促销。
### Step 3) Create Urgency and Social Proof Incentivizing Desired Actions
Fake dwindling inventory alerts and dubious customer reviews further compel reactively seeking scarce free goods rather than questioning contradictory abnormalities.
然而，隐藏的订阅条款悄悄授权了来自可疑合作伙伴的昂贵未经授权的每月重复收费，而不是公开披露的10美元限制内预期的合理一次性付款。
> *"Only 8 free Le Creuset sets still remain thanks overwhelming demand from Ree's fans!"* warnings pressure visitors. *"Hurry and claim yours before it's too late!"*
### Step 4) Covertly Collect Users' Financial Information and Personal Data
最终，受害者实际上并没有收到承诺的长期高端Le Creuset烹饪产品。但由于机密信息被泄露，骗子通过地下数据销售渠道造成重大财务损害，这些渠道得益于最初为了追逐看似太好了而忽略的非凡节日优惠而粗心交出的信用卡或账户访问权限。
Customized online order forms under guise securing contest entries conveniently require private sensitive input exceeding reasonable needs justifying free cookware shipment logistics alone. Required details extend beyond contact information increasing risks enabling supplementary data exploitations and direct financial injuries.
### Step 5) Hide Recurring Charges in Fine Print Disclosures
## 诈骗运作方式
Buried deep within lengthy website terms and conditions passages reveal unwitting victims actually consent authorizing steep unexpected recurring monthly credit card charges exceeding $100 rather than reasonable one-time $10 product shipment costs depicted consistently across earlier advertisement materials.
### Step 6) Continuously Profit From Stolen Data and Recurring Theft
欺诈性的Ree Drummond Le Creuset赠品活动通过精心设计的欺诈流程吸引受害者，利用即使是最警惕的个人也会存在的弱点：
With widespread access provided through compromised confidential information, recurring bank account and/or credit card charges soon activate allowing scammers collecting payments long after victims realize promised expensive Le Creuset sets will never arrive.
And compromised personal data further enables potential resale through unregulated dark web black market channels -- each vector inflicting additional long-term financial and privacy damages upon manipulation victims falling for fictional celebrity-fronted contests leaving them utterly empty-handed.
### 第1步）通过深度伪造名人代言视频制造热度
In summary, the celebrity affiliated appliance scam ensnares social media users through emotional triggers, psychological pressure, urgency cues and concealed terms disclosing unreasonable recurring financial extraction objectives unrelated to initial marketing transparency first pitched for PR perception management.
How To Spot the Ree Drummond Le Creuset Giveaway Scam on Social Platforms
诈骗始于使用人工智能深度伪造生成的视频，虚假模拟Ree Drummond热情支持节日Le Creuset赠品活动。她的Food Network知名人格识别度建立了初步的社交热度，并扩大了欺诈转化率的覆盖范围，使其以前所未有的规模扩大。
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
In addition to external fraudulent websites, the supposed Ree Drummond free Le Creuset giveaway also flows heavily through major social channels like Facebook, Instagram and TikTok using manipulated video content and psychological tactics deceiving users.
### 第2步）通过精心设计的外部钓鱼页面引导流量
Let's review what signals commonly expose the questionable cookware promotion on each platform.
### Facebook Tactics Exploiting the Le Creuset Giveaway

Document 1174: Chinese AI caught out by face in bus ad
Over-zealous AI systems in China have accused a woman pictured on the side of a bus of jaywalking.
中国过于“尽职”的AI系统误将一位印在公交车车身广告上的女性判定为乱穿马路者。
The face of Dong Mingzhu, who heads China's biggest air-conditioner maker, was briefly shown on a billboard used to shame those who flout traffic laws.
But the AI-based spotting system in Ningbo had reacted to the bus advert rather than Ms Dong herself.
中国最大空调制造商的掌门人董明珠的面孔，曾短暂地出现在一块用于曝光交通违法者的电子大屏上。
Police said they had deleted the photo and would update the jaywalker-spotting system to avoid similar mistakes.
Hard work
但宁波这套基于AI的识别系统实际上是对公交车广告做出了反应，而非董女士本人。
Traffic police in many Chinese cities have started using a variety of methods to stop people crossing streets unlawfully.
Many now rely on automatic camera-based systems that take pictures of people as they cross roads or mingle with traffic.领域
警方表示，他们已删除了该照片，并将更新乱穿马路识别系统以避免类似错误再次发生。
The images and names of jaywalkers are featured on large displays and warn people about the legal consequences of their actions.
Police in Ningbo said its public shaming of Ms Dong was a mistake as the AI system had spotted her face in an advert for Gree Electric Appliances - the business she runs.
**辛勤工作**
Local police acknowledged the mistake in a Sina Weibo blog and said the snap of Ms Dong had been deleted, reported the South China Morning Post.
Work was now taking place to ensure the AI-system could differentiate between ads and people, it added.
中国许多城市的交警已开始采用多种手段来制止行人违章过马路。
Gree Electric reacted by thanking the police for their hard work, the paper said.

It's not a big deal to jaywalk in India. Eight times out of ten, no one will even notice. But if you jaywalk in China, you might have to face something extremely embarrassing. While China has moved ahead of the rest of the world making facial recognition technology or the AI-backed cameras a part of everyday life, they are still not perfect.

Later, the traffic police of Ningbo recognised the mistake and deleted the image. It also said the surveillance system would be completely upgraded to cut incidents of false recognition in future.
